Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and overthrow the corrupt system, he must walk a lonely road to unrivaled power.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ผู้ปลุกพลังไร้ขีดจำกัด

197225.description:
Notes:
• Published in COMIC Potpourri Club 2013-07, 08, 10, 11, 2014-01, 03, 05, 06,
• An extra chapter is included

197226.description:
Lyra, a consort whose name will be passed down to future generations as a legend, was originally a princess of the Kingdom of Wa. She was captured in a conspiracy and forced into the harem of the Daril Empire. However, in this harem, she had a path to freedom if she remained childless for several years! This gave her hope, and she resolved not to approach the Sultan, but to wait until her term of indenture expired. However, she was soon tested by the Empress and provoked by a haughty consort candidate. Lyra overcame numerous adversities by displaying the intelligence and natural cheerfulness forged by her parents. She gradually became beloved by those around her, and even showed glimpses of her potential as a wise ruler... But as a result, why has she risen to the top and been treated as a favorite concubine?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: アラベスク後宮の和国姫

197227.description:
I want to be comforted so bad I can barely stand it!

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in COMIC Kairakuten BEAST 2025-09

197229.description:
Takashi has been a serious middle schooler, focusing on his schoolwork. But one day, he encounters with three cute little vampires, who are completely different from what he expected from usual "terrifying vampires."

Since then, Takashi's life turns upside down. Without Takashi's agreement, the vampires start living in his place, and calling him "Master." They work for him as servants, and act like his little sisters sometimes..!?

The three vampire sisters--Sayo, a traditional Japanese beauty, Mayfa, a placid girl in a Chinese dress and Dorothy, a lady in Gothic-Lolita dress--make reckless efforts with good intentions for their Master.

"Petite petite vampires" is an exciting boy-meets-vampire story!

(Source: Emanga)

title.native: ぷちぷちヴァンパイア

197230.description:
"Takashi Takasugi is the lowest-ranked student in his class, plagued by bad luck. He clashes with the protagonist, leaves the academy, and is rumored to have died—a truly unfortunate character."

That's how the game's strategy guide described him... and now, the protagonist finds himself reincarnated as this bottom-tier nobody!

Drowning in despair, he searches his classroom desk—only to discover the very strategy guide he bought in his previous life. "If I use this, I can become the strongest!?" Determined to escape his tragic fate, Takasugi sets off to secretly grind his skills in dungeons... but hardship awaits at every turn. However, when he starts traveling alongside the game's beautiful heroine, Hanagasaki, his destiny takes a dramatic turn!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: I Was Transmigrated as the Bottom-Tier of the Dungeon Academy, but I Have a Strategy Guide for Some Reason.

title.native: ダンジョン学園の底辺に転生したけど、なぜか俺には攻略本がある
title.romaji: Dungeon Gakuen no Teihen ni Tensei Shita kedo, Naze ka Ore ni wa Kouryaku Hon ga Aru

title.native: 帝国第１１前線基地魔導図書館、ただいま開館中
title.romaji: Teikoku Dai 11 Zensen Kichi Madou Toshokan, Tadaima Kaikan Chuu

title.native: Nostalgia world online～首狩り姫の突撃！あなたを晩ご飯！～＠ＣＯＭＩＣ
title.romaji: Nostalgia World Online: Kubikari Hime no Totsugeki! Anata wo Bangohan! @comic

197233.description:
A rising young director sets out to cast his next project and becomes fixated on a particular actor who refuses to be easily won over. A bold casting offer turns into an even bolder counterproposal, pulling the two into a delicate negotiation where ambition and attraction collide. As their collaboration moves forward, the line between work and romance begins to blur, setting the stage for a relationship neither of them planned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197234.description:
She always wanted to be a campus couple with someone, he just thought she was a weirdo with an impulsive streak. So what happens when what starts as a whim becomes something neither of them expected? Maybe love really does come when you least expect it...

(Source: Manta)

197235.description: Drakiwila is a vampire whose true form is a kiwi. This is a four panel comic about him and other beautiful yet strange monsters.

title.native: キウイケツキ　ドラキウイラ

197236.description:
Five years ago, an accident erased Ha Do-Geon’s memories. Even so, his life has remained mostly smooth, calm, and manageable. He believes the past he lost no longer matters. That illusion cracks the night he returns home after a university alumni event. His designated driver, Yang Ha-Il, is a stranger, yet the moment their eyes meet, something deep inside Do-Geon stirs. A gaze that feels unfamiliar but achingly known, an attraction he cannot explain. From that night on, Do-Geon’s carefully balanced life begins to shift. Emotions he does not remember choosing start to resurface, pulling him toward a man who feels tied to a time he was sure was gone forever. Caught between erased memories and revived feelings, Do-Geon is forced to confront the possibility that forgetting did not mean letting go.

As the past quietly pushes its way back into the present, Do-Geon must face the question he never thought he would ask again, what if the most important part of his life is the one he lost?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 地味子ちゃんの乳首当てゲーム
いじめられっ子と引きこもり

197242.description:
Kazuya Niimi, a student at a music university, is known for having "immobile fingers"—hardly fitting for someone aspiring to be a pianist. One day, due to a sudden twist of fate, Kazuya finds himself lost in another world. In this strange new world, men are not treated as people—it is a society of overwhelming female supremacy and male subjugation. But in that world, Kazuya notices something strange happening to his body. His fingers now hold a mysterious power. Fingers that cause anyone they touch to physically react.

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)
synonyms: The world that becomes wet at my fingertips

title.native: 俺の指先で濡れる世界
title.romaji: Ore no Yubisaki de Nureru Sekai

197243.description: With a height of 192 cm and a scar on his face, Ujioka Tasuku is mistaken for a “scary person” by those around him, and his student life has been lonely up until now. On his first day of high school, Ujioka is determined to make friends and have a fun high school life, but a shocking encounter with Shimohoshizaki Kodzuru awaits him after she trips on a banana peel! She's completely out of it, but Ujioka is touched by Shimohoshizaki's hard work and she doesn't judge Ujioka by his appearance, so they decide to become friends!? They're beginners at both friends and youth, but together, they'll do their best in their youth!!

title.native: 君はおれの優しくない春
title.romaji: Kimi wa Ore no Yasashikunai haru

197244.description:
The future looks bleak for Sophelia von Lotus. The behavior of her arranged fiancé, the crown prince, leaves much to be desired, and her family makes her feel like a stranger in her own home. Even so, she is committed to her duties as the future crown princess, enduring hardship and humiliation alike for the good of the kingdom. That is, until Sophelia catches her husband-to-be in a compromising position with her younger sister!

Seeing her chance to escape the miserable future awaiting her, Sophelia screams to alert everyone to her fiancé's indiscretion, and help comes running in the shape of Sir Livionis, a dashing knight (and longtime secret admirer) who urges her to run away with him. Abandoning the only life she has ever known, Sophelia takes his hand and tumbles into a heartstopping romance and a completely new life. But what awaits this young couple as a new love rings?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The beginning bell rings when I witnessed my fiancé cheating.

title.english: My Fiancé Cheated, But a New Love Rings!
title.native: 婚約者の浮気現場を見ちゃったので始まりの鐘が鳴りました THE COMIC
title.romaji: Konyakusha no Uwaki Genba wo Michatta node Hajimari no Kane ga Narimashita THE COMIC

title.native: わらべ団地のまりなちゃん

197246.description: Nora lives in a world that is a little different from the real world. In this slightly devastated world, she bakes bread using a secret recipe passed down from her ancestors, and then eats it. Such simple activities gradually become her connection to this world!

197247.description:
She was a female imperial general who unexpectedly crossed into the modern world. Kidnapped by a trash system, she was forced to do tasks to become a top star. Assertive and beautiful, she pedals forth into the entertainment industry with her high sense of self-discipline and strong temperament. Each one of her unrestrained and unconventional methods were pieces that attracted her a large number of diehard fans, even grabbing the attention of the viral emperor of the internet Gu Beihuai. With successive and rigorous training, she climbs all the way to top.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: The Queen Starts as an A-Lister
The Queen Starts From the Top

197248.description:
“You’re less than garbage as a servant!”

Gald, a boy working as a servant for an Earl’s family, is expelled one day. With nowhere to go, Gald decides to enroll in a magic academy, something he never did in his previous life.

In his past life—Gald was the strongest sage in history!

In the entrance examination for the world's most prestigious magic academy, Gald, a commoner, surpasses nobles who can only use intermediate-level magic, demonstrating mastery over the highest level of magic, overwhelming them!

After enrolling, Gald continues to use his overwhelming power as a sage, defeating all enemies in the arena and dungeons alike, enjoying his academy life alongside two beautiful girls he met there, Yuri and Sasha.

title.native: ゴミ以下だと追放された使用人、実は前世賢者です ～史上最強の賢者、世界最高峰の学園に通う～
title.romaji: Gomi Ikada to Tsuihou Sareta Shiyounin, Jitsu wa Zense Kenja Desu: Shijou Saikyou no Kenja, Sekai Saikouhou no Gakuen ni Kayou

197249.description:
Once a rising star in the popular band Rookie, Connie suddenly vanished from the spotlight after a fellow member stole one of his songs. He quit the band without explanation and disappeared from the public eye. Five years later, after constant persuasion from his longtime fan Louie, Connie reluctantly joins a band at his college called Dead Core, and instantly becomes the talk of campus. But things get complicated when his mysterious roommate Mika, who seems oddly familiar, begins inserting himself into Connie’s life. From day one, Mika insists they’d make the perfect graduation project partners…and he’s not taking no for an answer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: アシスタリアン ～ヤンデレエイリアンはエロ漫画家に愛されたい～
title.romaji: Assist Alien: Yandere Alien wa Eromagaka ni Aisaretai

title.native: 穢れた聖地巡礼について
ロマンチックが似合わない

197255.description:
When he drinks, he ends up wailing in tears or kissing the first person he sees... Kai Hoshino is a terrible drunk.

When Kai decided to become a hairdresser, just like the man who changed his life, this newbie stylist finally lands a job at the same salon as his idol, Sena! Although Sena was sweet and kind to Kai when he was a customer, working-Sena is anything but! He is mean, orders Kai around, and is a total jerk. Talk about being disillusioned!

But before the shock even had time to settle, Kai is invited to a welcome party, where he meets his worst enemy...alcohol. Knowing his horrible drinking habits, Kai tries to avoid drinking too much, but nothing seems to go poor Kai's way.

When a tad too much alcohol leaves Kai a bumbling, rambling mess, Sena sees a new, much cuter side to the newbie. The heat turns up as the spice grows stronger...will Kai's bad habits send him deeper into even more trouble with this handsome hairdresser?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197257.description:
At the Royal Academy of Magic, Lariet Blackwood has it all. She has a brilliant mind, flawless looks, and unmatched magical skill. Her only flaw is Demian Dominique, her infuriating rival. One day, the two fall victim to the wicked scheme of a creature called Lustmouth and find themselves trapped inside a mysterious labyrinth with a deadly mission to complete. If they fail to carry it out, they die. Thus begins a dangerous game that tests their lives, their love, and their deepest desires.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: I'm Stuck With My Dog-Like Enemy
I Got Stuck With My Damn Enemy

197258.description:
William’s life is upended by the sudden death of the mafia boss who had kept him as a lover… In the aftermath, the boss’s adopted son—known only as Nine—appears at William's door, claiming he has nowhere else to go. Nine seems eager to weave his way into William's heart, but William can't be sure of his motives. The organization is convinced that Nine killed his father. And yet, as William begins to pull at loose ends, the truth becomes even more tangled. Now, William is drawn deeper into a web of desire and lies, where every choice could ensnare him—and where the one who seems closest may be the most dangerous of all.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197259.description:
"They're so blue and clear. They look like they're shimmering." He was the only person who would describe the eyes Sowa hates so much like that.

Sowa doesn't have any friends. His sharp, cold eyes attracted only delinquents to his side. He lives his days filled with fighting, tussling, and pain. But one day, the basketball club's vice-captain, Kyoshiro, approaches him. The dependable, popular, and all-smiles senpai is the direct opposite of everything Sowa is. He tries everything to avoid the glowing beam of sunlight that is Kyoshiro, but...

The caring, handsome senpai x the aloof and clumsy lone-wolf kohai.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 今世で最後の恋をしよう
title.romaji: Konse de Saigo no Koi wo Shiyou

197261.description:
Han Ga-Ram enrolls in a prestigious arts university at the heart of Korea's classical music scene, an institution that has produced world-renowned musicians. His academic advisor, Professor Kim Hui-Jae, a world-famous pianist, exploits Han Ga-Ram's passion for his own ambition...

"What you hold dearest will become your greatest pain."
synonyms: エウリュディケはいない

197262.description:
Kyuusuke, a Dragonewt exiled for being unable to eat people, encounters Miyama, a popular streamer. Trapped and with his true identity exposed, Kyuusuke gets the most sensitive part of his tail stroked, and he can't resist the pleasure...?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: メランコリックシュガーテイル

197263.description:
On his way home from track practice just before an important competition, Yukiya from the track and field club witnesses a bag-snatching incident. He uses his impressive speed to catch the thief, but just as he does, he’s suddenly engulfed in a mysterious light and transported to another world. The one who summoned him is a boy named Daryu, who appears to be under a curse.

"Form a contract with me." While Yukiya struggles to make sense of the situation, Daryu demands his blood to break the curse and return to his original form. Just then, they are attacked by vicious beasts and suspicious men in black. Soon, Yukiya learns that the boy whose life is being targeted is actually Darius, the second prince of the kingdom. What will Yukiya do next?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

197264.description:
Amane, a high school girl in the photography club. One day, she hears that her boyfriend, who goes to a different school, is hanging out with another girl. Curious and suspicious, she asks her junior club member to come along as a photographer so they can follow him.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 君は知らない I love you
title.romaji: Kimi wa Shiranai I Love You

synonyms: 彼と彼の意地悪な距離 番外編
Kare to Kare no Ijiwaru na Kyori Bangai-hen

197266.description: An anthology comic of Yowamushi Pedal by various mangaka.
synonyms: Yowamushi Pedal Tribute After School Pedal: High Cadence

title.native: 「弱虫ペダル」公式アンソロジー　放課後ペダル　ハイケイデンス
title.romaji: Yowamushi Pedal Koushiki Anthology: Houkago Pedal - High Cadence

197267.description:
The "Magic Tower" develops magical tools and potions. Sophia, the daughter of a viscount, finally gets her dream job at the Magic Tower, but what awaits her is a brutal work environment and constant constant pressure to die from overwork. One day, Sophia learns that she has been betrayed by the Tower's owner, whom she trusted. In despair, she decides to escape the Tower. She develops a potion that allows her to take the form of a child and blends in with the children at an orphanage to escape the Tower. There, she catches the eye of a duke who is looking for an adopted daughter. The duke's brother and father dote on Sophia, and she tries to enjoy her happy life as a "beloved little girl." However, a boy named Adam, the same age as Sophia, appears before her in his little girl form. It seems he has a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The beloved fake little girl of the Duke family

title.native: 公爵家の愛されニセ幼女

197268.description:
"What's with the flower all of a sudden?"

A story about certain boy’s unrequited love for 25 years.

Notes:
- Released as a webcomic on Pixiv and Twitter.
- Includes one new chapter upon release at COMITIA 147.

197269.description:
Hanbyeol possesses a unique, irresistible scent that acts as a powerful siren call to all wolves. This biological quirk has defined much of her life, but it finally leads to a dream come true: a political marriage to Taesan, the formidable wolf hybrid she has secretly pined for since youth. However, the initial euphoria of their union quickly dissipates as the harsh reality of their physical differences sets in. As a mere human, Hanbyeol finds herself overwhelmed by the sheer intensity and primal needs of a powerful predator like Taesan. Terrified that her inability to keep up will lead to their estrangement, Hanbyeol realizes that standard devotion won't be enough to sustain their bond. Driven by an obsessive desire to satisfy her husband and prove her worth, she makes a drastic, life-altering decision to push her human limits. To truly belong to the wolf she loves, Hanbyeol prepares to take on whatever she can to stay with Taesan.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197270.description:
The tiger I saved as a child suddenly appeared as two companions?! And they say we three must sleep together for their souls to become one again?

"Our wife is truly clumsy, trapping her husband between her legs like this-"

"You wanted to touch it, didn't you...? A man's body."

Living as newlyweds with two divine beings who pounce on me at all hours - can my heart really endure this?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

197271.description:
Yeji lives alone in a run-down apartment complex, where every day feels the same—until she starts noticing the man next door. Her neighbor, a jobless middle-aged man, keeps mostly to himself, quiet and distant but oddly gentle. Their connection begins in small ways: sharing instant noodles, watching movies together, trading casual words that linger a little too long. He never gives her more than that, never a promise, never his heart, but Yeji can’t help being drawn in by his quiet warmth and the mystery behind his eyes. One evening, the air shifts. A glance lingers too long, a touch lasts too much, and Yeji finally blurts out,

“You couldn’t take your eyes off me… and you touched me, didn’t you?”

Between the thin walls of their lonely apartments, a subtle tension grows, half yearning, half hesitation, where comfort and desire slowly begin to blur.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197272.description:
Mi-A was Tae-Su's first love, who suddenly disappeared one day. After five years of silence, she reappears as a freshman at his university. But she's not the girl he remembers. He plays it cool, trying to ignore her, but can first love truly be forgotten? Or will fate give them a second chance?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: 元カノにまた恋してもいいですか？

197274.description:
In a world where polluted rain falls endlessly, a young girl lives under the protection of an artificial life form boy. One day, they venture out on a shopping trip to a distant town amidst the rain...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Published in Harta vol. 119.

197275.description:
Juyeon falls for her professor, Jeonghyeok, at first sight. After four years of nursing a one-sided crush, she finally works up the courage to confess, only to receive a shocking proposition from him...

“I'm going to introduce you to ---- next week. I want you to meet them.”

“What you're saying is…”

“I’m telling you to sleep with them as well. And then, bring me proof.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

197276.description:
For her entire life, Dohee has lived under the suffocating control of others, first repressed by her overbearing parents and later by a restrictive husband. To the outside world, she is the picture of grace, gentle, polite, and perfectly submissive. Yet, beneath that polished exterior, there is a constant, palpable tension, as if she is perpetually on the verge of breaking under the weight of her own restraint.

Her carefully constructed world begins to crack when she crosses paths with Kim Hyeon. With a single, provocative observation, he pierces through her mask and sees the raw, simmering desire she has fought so hard to bury. This chance encounter acts as the key to her long-guarded cage. Tempted by Hyeon’s boldness, Dohee begins to unlock the chains of her controlled existence, venturing into a world of liberation and forbidden passion where she finally takes what she wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197277.description:
Yeona and her three longtime friends have shared an unshakable bond for years, one so familiar it feels safe from romance. Believing none of them see her as a woman, she lets her guard down and falls asleep at Taehyeok’s place. But in the stillness of the night, a lingering touch awakens desires that have been carefully hidden, and a single moment of weakness begins to unravel their friendship into something far more dangerous and irresistibly tempting.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 내가 잠이 든 사이(feat. 나쁜 친구들)
title.romaji: Naega Jami Deun Sai (feat. Nappeun Chingudeul)

197278.description:
"That's right, you don't know me, do you? My name is..."

From the moment they first meet, Lily knows Aiden in an uncannily precise way. Terrified that his secret might be revealed, Aiden starts doing whatever she asks. As he follows her lead, he begins to feel an inexplicable pull toward her, and his curiosity about Lily only grows stronger...

(Source: DAYcomics)

197279.description:
Bonita is a pharmacist who works with rare ingredients that require foraging in dangerous places. She hires Ivan for a short-term contract as her bodyguard, but things take a turn on their first day when he is dosed with one of Bonita’s ingredients, which happens to be an aphrodisiac. Determined to help Ivan out of his hard circumstances, Bonita takes a heated approach to give him a hand. From there, coincidences keep leading to sexy encounters between them. Will this be a fling that lasts only until the end of their contract, or will this become something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

197280.description:
My "off-the-beaten-path potion" saves everyone! The life reversal of an oppressed medicine doctor!

Kuna, an incompetent and oppressed magician, is banished to the "Forest of Death" for a crime she did not commit. There, she meets a wolf named Roy, who leads her to the town of Wes, where the legend of a saint is passed down from generation to generation.

Kuna is befriended by Luca, an adventurer who accidentally saves her life, and she discovers the joy of helping others as a medicine doctor, but what's that? Wasn't my potion a "miss," meaning that it had no effect?

Meanwhile, in the village of Aco, where she was born and raised, something strange is happening. I'm an unaware genius medicine doctor, and I'll be happy here in exile!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 薬売りの聖女 ～冤罪で追放された薬師は、辺境の地で幸せを掴む～
title.romaji: Kusuriuri no Seijo: Enzai de Tsuihou Sareta Kusushi wa, Henkyou no Chi de Shiawase wo Tsukamu

197281.description:
A boy meets a cursed beast on a road at the edge of a forest. A demi-human becomes the servant of a wealthy mistress. A witch and her familiar chat it up. These and other stories of cross-species communication by Suzuka Morino have been compiled into a beautiful collection filled with the author's exquisite linework.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: The Works of Suzuka Morino: On the Road of Boundary

title.english: On the Boundary's Road: The Works of Suzuka Morino
title.native: 境界の道で 森野鈴鹿作品集
title.romaji: Kyoukai no Michi de: Morino Suzuka Sakuhinshuu

197282.description:
Joo-Heon and Seo Kang-Woo met at a university drinking party, were drawn to each other, and became lovers after a one-night stand . Kang-Woo expected a normal relationship, but Joo-Heon's rough and unruly behavior, seemingly devoid of emotion at crucial moments, ultimately leads to a breakup.

"You're the kind of person who can't love anyone, so live alone and never see anyone again."

Joo-Heon tries to appear calm, but Kang-Woo's absence makes him increasingly worn out, and he finally seeks out Kang-Woo in a precarious state and holds him captive.

"I'll fix that, even though I was sometimes harsh. I won't do it again... Just stay like this for ten minutes, no, just one minute."

Kang-Woo can't refuse Joo-Heon's desperate plea, almost pathetic, and ends up accepting him. The painful regret and intense love of two people who have lived completely different lives— and the law of cause and effect.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

197283.description:
A sudden accident leaves Ha-Seong unable to continue his athletic career. With his future uncertain, Isaac, an angel—no, a stranger—grabs his hand. Isaac, calling Ha-Seong his muse, makes Ha-Seong a shocking offer: "Be my nude model." But somehow, this man... seems to only care about her body.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: 理想情人: 畢馬龍效應

197284.description:
Min Jeong-Ho, who has been in love with Song Min-woo since they were young, follows him like a shadow, never leaving school, work, and even business trips. On a trip abroad alone, a plane crash lands them on a deserted island...

"Don't come any closer! Get off me!"

"It's just us here. Why should I do that?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: แสนวุ่นวายเพราะนายขี้ตื๊อ

title.native: ハッピーアンチモラル

197286.description:
New homeowner Yohan Hong is on top of the world—until his first night reveals an unwelcome, paranormal housemate. Fortunately, salvation appears in the form of a young coworker named Philip Go, whose mysterious ability to keep this specter at bay makes him the perfect new tenant...

(Source: Manta)

title.native: 初対面の男にダマされて、ヤリモクパーティーに参加した話。
title.romaji: Shotaimen no Otoko ni Damasarete, Yarimoku Party ni Sanka Shita Hanashi.

197288.description:
"Ao" is located in the east of the continent. While it is known as a great power, its slums are filled with orphans. Karyou, a girl who grew up in the slums, was taught to kill from a young age and has made a living as an assassin. Her next target is Emperor Rougetsu, who rules the country and is known as a tyrant. Karyou infiltrates the castle of the Emperor, also known as the Cursed Emperor, but...

(Source: Flacomi Like, translated)

title.native: 殺し屋は今日も冷徹皇帝に愛される
title.romaji: Koroshiya wa Kyou mo Reitetsu Koutei Aisareru

197289.description:
Prince Edward, Mariabelle's fiancé, suddenly dissolves their engagement, telling her he has found his true love. His new fiancée, Anette, is a commoner, and Edward requests that Mariabelle be her tutor because she is "the perfect lady." After firmly rejecting his request, Mariabelle receives another marriage proposal. However, upon finding this out, Edward tries to bring Mariabelle back to him...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Broke off Our Engagement Because He's Found True Love? Too Late to Come Crawling Back!
title.native: 真実の愛を見つけたと言われて婚約破棄されたので、復縁を迫られても今さらもう遅いです！
title.romaji: Shinjitsu no Ai wo Mitsuketa to Iwarete Konyaku Haki Sareta node, Fukuen wo Semararete mo Imasara mou Osoi desu!

title.native: 天の星はただの光 ー俺だけがセックスできない教室ー
title.romaji: Sora no Hoshi wa Tada no Hikari: Ore dake ga Sex Dekinai Kyoushitsu

197291.description:
A second-year middle school student busy with her idol activities, ends up taking photos for the boys' volleyball team's album. As soon as he starts taking photos, he becomes obsessed with the adorable volleyball team member, Saki Yumeno! From that day on, she begins spending her days gazing at her "second oshi."

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 好きです、夢追う夢くん

197292.description:
This is a fantasy set on the Sanzu River, which flows between the world of the living and the world of the dead. The story begins when a young girl named Purin, who is near death in the world of the living, wanders into the Sanzu River to visit Eva, a witch who lives on the Sanzu River.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 川辺のエヴァと異人たち

197293.description:
Honoka is a high school girl who always keeps her whole body covered. Honoka, who moves in response to any evil around her, has a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197294.description:
A busybody lawyer, Asuma, ends up helping a drunken hairdresser named Shion he finds collapsed on the street after a long night of work. But the next morning, Shion shows him a body covered in hickeys and bite marks, saying, “You don’t remember? You were so naughty,” leaving Asuma completely panicked. What the hell did I do…?

Asuma, a total workaholic, finds his routine thrown off ever since Shion started barging into his life. Sharing home-cooked meals, having warm, cozy moments, even getting into little arguments… nothing’s been the same since.

(Source: Libre, translated)

Notes:
- Chapters 1 and 5 were split into two parts in the original serialization. For the volume release, the second part of Chapter 1 was labeled as Chapter 2 while Chapter 5 was combined.
- Includes 15 extra chapters.

197295.description:
Suzuko is a duke's daughter whose hobby is collecting ghost stories. One day, while consulting a client about a strange phenomenon, she meets a young merchant named Takafuyu Hanabishi. He is possessed by the spirit of a noblewoman dressed in a twelve-layered kimono, and Suzuko witnesses the spirit eating the spirit of a geisha who had been possessing the client.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Exorcism Diary of Hanabishi Couple

197296.description:
The job of a grim reaper is to help the dead find nirvana and send their souls to the underworld. Kawai and Uemura, two grim reapers, work at such a place, but their incompetence always makes things difficult...

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

197297.description:
Yuito finally landed a job, only to get fired because of his large build. With no savings and unsure if he should return to his parents’ home, he runs into his childhood friend Tamotsu, who offers to let him stay over. When Tamotsu confesses he’s liked him since they were kids, Yuito feels happy and decides to take things further, kissing him, and before they know it, they end up sleeping together.

But the next morning, something completely unexpected happens to Yuito’s body… he’s shrunk down to a palm-sized doll! Even so, Tamotsu, now his boyfriend as well as his childhood friend, insists he’s adorable no matter what form he’s in!?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 手のひらサイズの君にキス
title.romaji: Tenohira Size no Kimi ni Kiss

197298.description:
Miki Shinya, a rookie salesman, is sick of being pampered every day because of his naturally baby-faced looks. His seniors call him “puppy-like,” and the women in the office say they want to pat his head. But deep down, he wants to be a dependable man, just like his admired chief Jin. Jin is the complete opposite of him, someone everyone relies on and looks up to. Shinya has always respected him.

One day, Shinya gets the chance to learn some “sales techniques” directly from Jin. He is thrilled to have a one-on-one lesson, but in the middle of it, Jin suddenly pats his head. On impulse, Shinya tries to pat Jin back to vent his usual frustration, but something seems different about Jin’s reaction.

Wait, could it be that the chief actually wants to be pampered?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197299.description:
Midori, who has a past of being humiliated as a “dog” by his classmates, has been living a peaceful university life far away from his hometown. But after a year passes since his enrollment, everything changes when a handsome new student named Sugihara joins the same club as him.

“I am not threatening you, I'm loving you.”

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197300.description:
At a mixer, Asagiri jokingly kissed a handsome guy named Nanase on a whim. A few days later, Nanase suddenly appears in front of Asagiri and says something shocking…?!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 七瀬くんとはキスするな

197301.description:
Rewind Syndrome is a rare disease that causes one's body to revert back to the past. Yukihiko takes advantage of this disease to find men more muscular than him on his secret account, and enjoys having sex with well-hung guys ♪
One day, a guy named Nagi shows up as his partner for the night, but his behavior is strange...?!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197302.description:
“You know, there’s nothing I haven’t managed to make mine until now.”

Ryouta, who was born into a branch family of the Kuon group, has been working hard everyday despite being tormented by his hidden inferiority complex for the eldest son of the main family, Shizuka. One day, something that Shizuka says makes Ryouta snap, and the feelings he had been bottling up explode, but for some reason, Shizuka then forcibly kisses him. Taken aback, he punches Shizuka with all his might, but Shizuka is smiling happily at the sight of Ryouta shedding his “good boy” mask. After that day, Ryouta’s feelings for Shizuka that he thought he had put a lid on when he was a kid start to become impossible to ignore…

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Sweet Silence that Drives Me Crazy

title.native: 俺を狂わすあまい静寂

197303.description:
Yuga Mitsuoka is a competent designer and the chief of his department. He's charming, handsome, well - liked by his coworkers, and an all - around flawless guy. However, he's got a secret that he can't tell anyone... and it involves a deep - rooted insecurity about his chest! Because of this, he can't even go to the public baths out of fear of his secret being discovered. One day, he visits his usual chiropractor, only to find a young man in the doctor's stead. The massage therapist offers Yuga a "special massage," which seems to get increasingly handsy as he begins to rub Yuga's chest...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Massage Therapist's Secret Chest Treatment
title.native: 秘密の陥没乳首開発中

197304.description:
Creme has spent his life acting as a guardian to his younger siblings, looking after them until they get married. But by putting his family first, he ends up neglecting his own dream of getting married. Just when all hope seems lost, a marriage proposal arrives. However, his potential partner turns out to be none other than a wolf—a sheep's natural enemy. Despite the risk, Creme sets off to meet the wolf. Upon arriving, he's bombarded with demands and given an unexpected glow-up, before finally coming face to face with Akiya, his future mate. With the sheep trembling in fear before him, Akiya traces Creme's neck with his tongue and asks, "So you've come to be eaten, lamb?" But what are his true intentions...?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Baa-chelor No More! - The Sheep Who Dreamed of Marriage

197305.description:
Eli’s boy band VINKS has just made their big debut—and as the youngest in the group, far from having everything handed to him as an alpha, he has to work twice as hard! One day, he participates in a session with Lee Suyoung from the top-ranked, all-alpha group α-code. For Eli, a longtime fan, it’s a dream come true. But what’s this sweet smell coming from Suyoung? Before he knows it, Eli’s mouth is heading for Suyoung’s nape… It’s only one month until α-code’s big comeback. What will they do, now that Eli knows Suyoung’s secret?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
197305.hashtag: #カムバック・アフター・フェイト

title.native: カムバック・アフター・フェイト

197306.description:
Come on, just hurry up and hate it already!

In this love comedy about silly, erotic childhood friends, Chiharu, a college student with a sex addiction, is troubled by his insatiable sexual desire. Whenever he has free time, he masturbates and has sex with girls. This gets him to thinking, "If I have sex with a man, maybe I'll hate sex…!?" When he asks his childhood friend and best friend, Rei, he reluctantly accepts it. However, when they actually get down to business, he doesn't hate it at all. "I might not be able to hate sex if it's with you." Unless he figures something out, he'll never escape the cycle and cure his sex addiction…!!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Make Love to Me Until I Can't Stand It Anymore
title.native: 嫌になるまで抱いてくれ
title.romaji: Iya ni Naru made Daite Kure

197307.description:
"Kuon... You're actually a huge pervert, aren't you?"
This sexy BL centers on a super sadistic underclassman who feigns innocence and his handsome, cordial upperclassman!

Kuon, who is followed everywhere by his clingy underclassman Hojo, is worried about something―it seems as though Hojo's always unwittingly being naughty towards him! Hojo hugs Kuon or squeezes his butt whenever he gets the chance, and Kuon's body begins to tremble in response to the slightest touch. Kuon thus attempts to create some distance between them to prevent Hojo from learning about his reactions. However, slipping his hands under Kuon's shirt, Hojo boldly declares, "I've been fantasizing about making love to you." Was Hojo planning this all along?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 久遠せんぱいはセクハラ中毒

197308.description:
University student Sakura wants love, but always ends up being a friend with benefits… That's when Mama from the gay bar introduces him to a sexy man holding red roses called Yonezawa! Whispering loving words like a skilled escort, Sakura's completely smitten on this date of his dreams. Before he realized, his body's melting under the sweet kisses and long fingers…! “We're lovers now, aren't we?" Does he finally have the man of his dreams!? This is a love story between a perfect man who's madly in love and a university student who's terrible at romance!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 這位完美男神的愛極其沉重！～理想的男人竟然是偏執男！？

title.english: This Darling Man has a Fastidiously Strong Love! ~The Man of My Dreams is Obsessed with Me!?~
title.native: このスパダリ、とびきり愛が重い！～理想の男は執着ヤバめ!?
title.romaji: Kono Supadari, Tobikiri Ai ga Omoi!: Risou no Otoko wa Shuuchaku Yabame!?

197309.description:
Hey, will you teach me? About cameras, about you, about everything...
He's younger, and a he. But still, the caresses from his fingers and lips and tongue set everything alight...!

Photographer Minori Hinata is specifically requested for an advertising shoot by the hot young model Riu Fujisaki. The shoot's concept? "Jewelry that looks best on bare skin during sex." At first, Minori thinks Riu is kind of arrogant and aloof, but as they work, Riu's stunning eyes and sculpted body pull him in, enchanting Minori in an instant. That's when Riu, exuding cosmic levels of sex appeal, pushes Minori down! Minori is helpless against the sensual touches to his nipples and wet mouth caressing his skin... This is a love story between a possessive young model and an accomplished, in-demand photographer!

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

197310.description:
One day, Archar, a rookie adventurer, rescues Dirk, a beastman warrior who has collapsed from hunger. Dirk is attracted to the kind-hearted Archar and starts working with him under the pretext of "wanting to return the favor." One night, a few weeks after they start taking on quests together, Archar is feeling guilty because Dirk is always the one defeating their enemies in battle, so he asks Dirk if he can do something for him in return. Dirk, full of ulterior motives, tells the innocent Archar that he's in heat and that he needs Archar to "help him out." Archar can't take his eyes off the tanned beastman who's hungrily begging for him!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 獣人お兄さんただいま発情中！？

197311.description:
To be an adventurer means facing dangerous monsters for riches and rewards. But not every mission is a successful one, and not every adventurer makes it out. That’s where Nemu comes in. As a corpse bearer, Nemu is tasked with finding fallen fighters and slaughtered supports in the very dungeon that killed them. It’s a dangerous job with a bad reputation, but to Nemu, it’s just a paycheck. One day while on a job, she runs into Garensis, an injured explorer who seems fascinated by her. Suddenly, her usually solitary run becomes far noisier.

Searching for his sister, Garensis is sure that he’ll be successful if he sticks with Nemu and tags along, despite her indifference. But he’ll find that there’s much more to the role of corpse bearer than just fetching the dead… if Nemu lets him.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

197312.description:
One day, Tori overhears his brother's best friend Shima confessing his love for his brother. Although they don't end up going out, Tori can't hide his shock that it was his brother who Shima loved... and, what had felt like special treatment was just Shima treating him like a little kid. But, later on the way to school, something happens that makes Tori think he might just have a chance after all, and he decides to get Shima's attention by taking the physical approach! Tori's so determined to win Shima's love that he doesn't realize the target of Shima's affections actually isn't his brother...

In this cute comedy of errors, a shy-but-naughty bottom and his brother's handsome friend fumble their way to passionate love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 紫真くんにぜんぶあげる

197313.description:
Jade, a soldier, is abandoned after being taken prisoner, only to be found by Rene, a member of a tribe known as “the Reaper’s Messengers.” Haunted by survivor’s guilt and the voices of his fallen comrades, Jade struggles with the weight of being the only one left alive. But Rene’s words and warmth slowly pull him out of his nightmares and back into reality.

As Jade finds himself drawn to Rene, he cannot bring himself to accept the tribe’s way of finding joy in death…

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197314.description:
Nightclub host Seiya is raising Tenma, the child of his late sister, with his neighbor and boyfriend Ibuki, who is a novelist. Their secret relationship is known only to a very few, but the days they spend as three are sweet and happy. One day, a first-time client visits the nightclub where Seiya works. The young man seems inexperienced and turns out to be Ibuki’s younger brother, who mistakenly believes hosts are deceiving his older brother. When even Tenma’s existence becomes known, Seiya struggles alone with his worries. Concerned, Ibuki suggests, “Let’s spend more time together as three of us. I want to be with you more.” Seiya realizes once again that life without Ibuki is unimaginable.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: The Host with a Little Boy and His Fantastic Neighbor
title.native: 子持ちホストの最高な隣人
title.romaji: Komochi Host no Saikou na Rinjin

title.native: 深夜0時のイけない秘密

197316.description:
A feared gangster. A forgotten past. A contract with a monster from Hell. When Dojin Hong's girlfriend is kidnapped, he awakens the power of Rakshasa and is thrust into a hidden world of Contractors, Exorcists, and deadly supernatural creatures. To save her, he'll have to become the very monster he's been trying to leave behind.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197317.description:
A former member of the best film studio in Korea, a genius marketer, and the only employee who failed his peer evaluation and was involved in a bribery case, a public enemy within the company. All of these modifiers summarize Han-Rok's life as an office worker. He only wanted to focus on his work, and he hated politics and flattery, so he rejected all lines, but the price he paid was betrayal and false accusations from those around him, and at that moment, he was at a loss... He returned to that day five years ago when everything started to go wrong. Han-Rok, who started to cross the line with the determination not to be taken advantage of again in this life, started to see a clue to the problem that had not been visible until then.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: When a Genius Office Worker Crosses the Line
When a Genius Office Worker Goes Too Far
When the Genius Employee Crosses the Line

197319.description:
Tsubaki's "duty" is to support the protective god, Shigure, in both his private life and his public job. Shigure is not just a god, but is also making a living as an author, and Tsubaki is a huge fan of his work. However, one of Tsubaki's duties is to offer his "devotion" to his god...the only small, tiny problem is that this little ritual always leaves Tsubaki reeling. His pulse races, his breathing gets labored...and his whole body heats up!

Tsubaki is struggling just to keep both his excitement and this growing crush a secret, but things never seem to go his way...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: If I Could Write My Love Into You
title.romaji: Kamisama Sakka wa Ai wo Tsuzuru

197320.description:
Notes:
- During serialization, Chapters 1, 3, 5 to 8, and 10 to 11 were split into two parts, while Chapters 2, 4 and 9 was split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume releases.
- Includes two extra chapters.
197320.hashtag: #わんと鳴いたらキスして撫でて #わんキス
synonyms: When He Barks, Kiss Him and Pet Him

title.native: わんと鳴いたらキスして撫でて
title.romaji: Wan to Naitara Kiss Shite Nadete

197321.description:
Life has never been easy for Nagata Kabi, but no matter what gets thrown her way, she manages to work through it and find peace in the chaos. In this latest diary manga, Kabi explores life living alone and the sudden appearance of an old doodle. Whether it’s all in her head or just a way to cope with loneliness, Kabi embraces the company, naming her Anko, and proceeds to share her daily tasks with her new friend. Despite the delusion, Kabi can’t help but long to continue the late-night meals and shared udon with such pleasant company.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 元らくがきとワンルーム暮らし

197322.description:
Sana, self-conscious about her weight, is confused by her manager Mr. Kusakabe's constant glare. One day, she slips on the stairs, but Mr. Kusakabe catches her, and her embarrassment grows, certain he now thinks she's heavy. But when she confronts him about his stares, he blushes and confesses his love, revealing his "glaring" was actually a sign of affection. He then asks her on a date in this cute office romance.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 日下部課長の恋はやわらか
title.romaji: Kusakabe Kachou no Koi wa Yawaraka

197323.description:
"Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!!

(Source : Mecha Comic, translated)

title.native: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました

197324.description:
Hyun-Jae Moon, a beta, has been in a loving relationship with alpha Shin-Hoo Lee for seven years. But all this changes when Shin-Hoo sacrifices himself to save Hyun-Jae from a terrible accident. When Shin-Hoo wakes up in the hospital, he doesn’t recognize Hyun-Jae or have any memories of their time together. All Shin-Hoo wants now is a man who can handle his intense desires, but does a beta have the stamina to keep up with him? With their relationship in shambles, how can Hyun-Jae win Shin-Hoo back?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: กลิ่นรักในความทรงจำ

197325.description:
A young girl named Anika who devotedly cares for an elderly witch. Underneath her deep hood, she hides a secret. A tale of bonds woven by their mutual affection.

(Source: Harta, translated)

197326.description:
A young man lost in the mountains encounters a mysterious man who warns him, "Today is a day when you must not enter the mountains."

(Source: Harta, translated)

197327.description:
A tale of human emotion set in the Edo period, centered around Yukinari, an executioner, and the people around him. In this era, most criminals faced execution. One day, Saichiro, the son of a town doctor, witnesses Yukinari executing a criminal. Later, Saichiro sees Yukinari ignoring the pleas of the criminal's family. Yukinari, who seems to regard people as mere objects, responds to Saichiro's inquiry about why he won't listen to the family by saying, "I merely execute the sentence." Saichiro was dissatisfied with the answer, but then something happened... The story of a man who kills and lives unfolds.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197328.description:
Honoka has been in love with her childhood friend and company president, Kei, for many years. Honoka had been waiting for Kei to marry her when he turned 30, believing him, but Kei ends up marrying a young lady he doesn't know for political reasons... Shocked, Honoka tries to use a brothel for women, but...!?

(Source: Flowercomi Like, translated)

197329.description:
A romance that begins when an abusive company president, Hiroumi, time-slips onto a 17th-century English ship. Confused, Hiroumi is called "Captain" by those around him, seeking instructions. Unable to return to the present and clueless about the situation, Hiroumi is determined not to become a useless incompetent and resolves to rise to the occasion...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197330.description:
Just before becoming a god of the Higher Realm, goddess Seirene is betrayed by her friend Arwen and loses all her "Human Entertainment Points." To earn them back, she’s reborn as the daughter of Targa, an imperial bastard prince, and is on a mission to make him none other than the next emperor!

(Source: Manta)

197331.description:
After losing her mother, Subaru enrolls in an all-girls school deep in the mountains. However, two female students have died in the school's tower!

(Source: Flowercomi Like, translated)

197332.description:
Asahi lives with a stray alien she met as a child. But one day, her alien companions arrive on Earth and begin attacking humans!?

(Source: Flowercomi Like, translated)

197333.description:
1, 3, 5. Netoraresou: Wana ni Hamatta Onnatachi (寝取られ荘～罠に嵌った女たち～); COMIC Mugen Tensei 2015-04, 07, 10
2. Kanpeki Kanojo (完璧彼女); COMIC MUJIN 2013-06
4. Class Change Shinobu-sensei (クラスチェンジシノブ先生); COMIC Mugen Tensei 2014-11
synonyms: クラスチェンジシノブ先生

title.native: 寝取られ荘～罠に嵌った女たち～

197334.description:
Newly-awakened hunter Habin Hyun is mankind’s only hope, but after many years of the minimum wage grind, all she wants to do is take a break. Unfortunately for her, her ridiculously broken stats catapult her into the spotlight in more ways than one. With every guild scouting her, the System’s bounty on her head, and love interests appearing from every angle, it seems Habin’s going to have to take her new friends and unlikely allies all the way to the Tower’s top, whether she likes it or not.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Even Today, the Ranker Dreams of Retirement
The Ranker Who Just Wants to Retire
The Ranker Dreams of Retirement Today Too

197335.description:
A no-holds-barred, full-on attack against the most vicious, useless guy!

Ririka falls in love at first sight with the handsome Itsuki, a man with 30,000 Instagram followers and a cute, airy face whose seduction techniques for wooing girls are beyond destructive. After she finally manages to say "I love you," he kisses her and says "See you later"... What!? This could be the start of a powerful, yet incredibly formidable, love affair!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: だってもうスキになっちゃったし

197336.description:
One day, Kisara, a young boy with psychic abilities who fights against the demons that nest and devour people's hearts, witnesses a strange incident at the cram school he attends. It involves a sudden change in a teacher and the mysterious presence of sand...

Kisara, a kinetic magician, and Jukuro, a static magician—the story of the battle between these two cousins begins now!!! A super-powerful psychic school fantasy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ハイスクール・オーラバスター・エンゲイジ

197337.description:
Annie Rose is a beautiful high-class prostitute from the small Western European country of Banoffee. Behind her angelic face, she secretly operates every night as a righteous thief known as "Miss Arsene"! If you even look at her, you're already stolen away...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197338.description:
Dahlia, Viola, and Lili are three beautiful witch sisters. They spend their days collecting the evil and poison of men in the human world, and the jealousy and envy of women, in order to increase their magical powers. Lili, a useless witch who has yet to get rid of any of her "evil," heads to the human world with a chocolate recipe made with a secret recipe. There, she meets Aya, a handsome delinquent...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: マジカル★ショートシリーズ

title.native: マジカルチョコレート

197339.description:
After changing jobs numerous times, Ji Songting becomes a forest ranger. He then discovers that this job is nothing like he imagined, both in terms of the difficulties of the position and the wonderful things it has to offer. Contemplating Taiwan's mountainous forests, lush and full of life, he will try to find his way.

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

197340.description:
The Taiwanese clouded leopard, also known as the Formosan clouded leopard, is a rare creature that is now extinct. These formidable predators live in a jungle full of dangers... where humans are increasingly encroaching. Their encounter, marked by both fear and admiration, will make these creatures the guardians of the visible and invisible worlds and witnesses to the great changes of our time...

Under the supervision of the National Museum of Taiwan, the author delicately depicts the affection between animals and humans. The title is recommended by the Taiwanese Ministry of Culture and was named a winner of the 2021 Golden Comic Awards.

(Source: Mahô Editions, translated)
synonyms: Le Fauve des nuées - Le Gardien des temps anciens

title.english: Beast of Clouds: A Guardian from Ancient Times
title.native: 雲之獸：來自遠古的守護者
title.romaji: Yun Zhi Shou: Laizi Yuangu De Shouhu Zhe

197341.description:
"Your 'curses' are nothing but 'blessings' to me."

In this modern world, tower-like dungeons known as "Matenrou" have appeared all over the world. Our protagonist, Takamichi Yoshito, is a convenience store clerk who feels miserable, constantly being yelled at by the store manager. Dreaming of making a fortune, Yoshito becomes a "conqueror" of the towers shortly after the skyscrapers appear. However, he has no savings to invest in weapons and equipment, and falls completely behind as a conqueror. Hoping for a sudden turnaround, Yoshito sells all of his real-life savings and the few items he has acquired in the Matenrou to purchase the skill "Infinite Revival" from a shady merchant, which allows for resurrection within the dungeon. However, "Infinite Revival" has a hidden drawback: upon resurrection, a "death penalty" is randomly applied, inflicting a powerful, permanent debuff so severe that even a single resurrection is enough to render him unable to survive as an adventurer. Yoshito despairs over this curse-like skill, but his situation changes when he obtains the rare skill "Reversal" in a hidden room in the dungeon. The skill "Reverse" reversed the severe negative effects of Yoshito's "Death Penalty" permanent debuff caused by "Infinite Resurrection", turning them all into positive effects...!

(Source: HykeComic, translated)
synonyms: Super Strengthening for Every Death -Death Penalty

title.native: 死んだ数だけ超強化 -デスペナルティ-
title.romaji: Shinda Kazu Dake Chou Kyouka: Death Penalty

197342.description: A group of classmates reunite in their hometown for the first time in a while. They rent a recreational boat and experience a fleeting sense of freedom, but in the sea lurks a giant man-eating shark. One after another, the youths fall prey to the shark. And when the boat breaks down during the shark attack, it's a desperate situation in the open ocean!

title.native: 惨劇海域～シャークパニック～

197343.description: A new "Isekai Cheat" story from Takeru Uchida, the creator of "Isekai Cheat Magician"!

title.native: 異世界チート戦士＆魔法使い

197344.description:
A military band that returned from hell. He abandoned light and chose darkness. The darkness he chose swallowed all darkness.... The world called him the Dark Lord and revered him as the Emperor of the Night. Forever... forever....

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

197345.description:
My place has always been by that woman's side. And the reason I'm there is to protect her. That's the meaning of my life. Where should I stop? There was never a destination in the first place!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

title.native: 百魔の主 異世界で魔王チートは最強かもしれません
title.romaji: Hyakuma no Aruji: Isekai de Maou Cheat wa Saikyou Kamo Shiremasen

197347.description:
The "flower disease" is a deadly disease caused by eerie flowers that invade the human body. Lazuli, a young girl born in a remote area, is separated by a wall between the "inside," where people are protected from the flowers, and the "outside," where people are constantly threatened by the flowers. To find out what happened to her childhood friend who went to the "inside" and never returned, Lazuli ventures into the "inside" to find out what happened...?

A dark fantasy romance!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197348.description:
A dark forest where all kinds of demons gather. A young boy named Gu-Nak enters the forest to escape his enemies. He survives among the hordes of demons and rakshasas and begins his quest for revenge.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

197349.description:
Ichika awakens to a special power after an incident that allows her to see spirits behind people at night. Her job as a housekeeping assistant, "Aoyane," is to perform any household chore upon request. Together with Rio, a mysterious man who has moved into Ichika's apartment, she once again listens to the silent voice of the person behind her...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: うしろに何かみえてますが

197351.description:
Erontropy is the power of love! The quest for love between a shrine maiden from another world and a high school shrine maiden begins!!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: エロントロピーが止まらない！～JK巫女のラブレッスン～
title.romaji: Erontropy ga Tomaranai!: JK Miko no Love Lesson

197352.description:
After guiding his 10,000th soul, Kai the reaper asks Shinos, the God of Death, to erase his very existence. But rather than meeting his end, Kai awakens in the body of Seian, the disgraced second son of House Shureyton. Forced to live a twisted life of regret and buried secrets, Kai must confront a past that isn’t his and find a way to rewrite a fate never meant to be. Can this once unfeeling reaper find redemption, or will his lesson in humanity end in destruction?

(Source: Tapas)

197353.description:
Nico is living with her grandmother while her parents are transferred overseas. She finds rural life inconvenient, but thinks it'll be comfortable once she gets used to it. She's startled by the creaking of the house and laments, "Old houses are scary after all!" Just then, a gecko appears! Nico is suspicious of the "house guardian" who has been protecting the house for a long time.

A city-bred girl and her guardian deity begin their strange cohabitation!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 放課後、にこいち暮らし
糸目の妻が寝取られたのは全て僕が原因だ・・・
title.romaji: Itome no Tsuma ga Netorareta no wa Subete Boku ga Genin da...

synonyms: NTR Video Letter - My Girlfriend is the Shared Onahole of a Remote Village

title.native: NTRビデオレター 僕の彼女は限界集落の共有オナホ
title.romaji: NTR Video Letter Boku no Kanojo wa Genkai Shuraku no Kyouyuu Onaho

title.native: チャラ男に寝取られる垂れデカ長乳母さん
title.romaji: Chara Otoko ni Netorareru Tare Deka Nagachichi Kaa-san

title.native: 僕はパパなんかじゃない
title.romaji: Boku wa Papa Nanka ja nai

197359.description:
Haru is a cheater and a lover. Haru has secret affair with a beautiful rich married woman. On his way home after having an affair, Haru finds Jushiro as he is about to throw himself off a bridge. Jushiro looked like a good target for Haru...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.romaji: Ai no Ma ni Ma ni

197360.description:
I know I shouldn't be falling in love, but I just can't help it.

Chikako, who had dreamt of going on a luxurious world cruise since she was a child, finally makes her dream come true. During her trip she is rescued from an accident by Masato, the CEO of the cruise company. She ends up staying in his suite and getting taken care of. Masato is the perfect gentleman, teaching her how to dance and showing her kindness, and Chikako's heart can't help but be drawn to him. However, out of the blue, he says, "I'd like to make a business transaction with you."

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: Sugar-Coated Cruise: The Heir's Infatuation with His Stand-in Fiancee
title.native: 溺甘クルーズ〜御曹司は身代わり婚約者に夢中です〜
title.romaji: Dekiama Cruise: Onzoushi wa Migawari Konyakusha ni Muchuu desu

197361.description:
Rookie police officer Shiomi meets his senior officer, Chief Sano, on his first day of work. Shiomi initially feels uncomfortable around Chief Sano, who is always looking out for him, but one day he realizes that Sano is watching over him with warmth, and gradually opens up.Shiomi is drawn to the friendly and reliable Chief Sano, and his feelings grow stronger.Then, in his second year on the force, Shiomi's wish finally comes true and he becomes Sano's partner. However, his joy is short-lived when he receives the news that "Chief Sano is getting married. "

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197362.description:
Thirtyish, gay, and too straitlaced for his own good, Yamada has never been great at finding romance. One evening, he turns to an app to get some loving, only for the shock of a lifetime to appear at his door: his hot coworker Takimiya, who’s a hit with guys and ladies alike! Yamada assumes they’ll just do their business and move on with their lives, but it looks like Takimiya has other ideas…

(Source: Yen Press)

Notes:
- Originally self-published, was then licensed and compiled by Kaiohsha for commercial release.
- Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: ドントトークトゥミー

197363.description:
"I wasn't supposed to go there in the first place."

‘Hyeok’, who started ‘Anonymous Chat’ because he was lonely, He even has drinks with strangers to relieve his loneliness. Then one day, news broke that one of the people attending the meeting had been killed. Hyeok feels suspicious as he reunites with the people he had been drinking with on the same day...

197364.description:
One day, I woke up to find that my best friend had become my lover.

Yagi Shouma, eighteen. I was supposed to be in love with Mizuki, my childhood friend, but when I woke up, there was Mizuki, who claimed to be my "boyfriend," all grown up. I am now an adult too, but it seems that I have lost seven years of memories. The adult Mizuki I don’t know is somehow sexy and unsettling, and it’s overwhelming for someone who has only just realized their first love…

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: How to Repair a Forgotten Love

title.english: How to Fall In Love with You Again

synonyms: グッバイミスタートップ

197368.description:
Takanashi Haru, a plain and unassuming boy with black hair and glasses, secretly has a crush on the popular teacher Nanjou. His crush is accidentally discovered by his classmate, Sanada Kazuki, a flashy and popular guy who is the complete opposite of Takanashi. Sanada takes an interest in Takanashi's unrequited love for Nanjou and tries to help Takanashi attract the teacher's attention. But as Takanashi starts spending more time with Sanada, he begins to experience Sanada's kindness... Maybe Sanada isn't just the flashy guy he appears to be...? What will become of this usual pairing...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

Notes:
- Chapters 5 and 7 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 萌ゆるハルに出会う僕ら

197369.description:
Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die. But death never came. A year later, she’s alive and farming, bickering with a tree fairy, and somehow the new Marchioness Maron. As secrets of the contamination zone begin to surface and the ghosts of her past return, Hailey must decide whether to seek vengeance or build something new from ruins. When survival itself becomes the greatest twist of fate, who needs revenge?

(Source: Tapas)

197371.description:
Saki, a mischievous succubus, suddenly pops up in front of Ao, a normal high school boy. The steamiest, wildest adventure is about to begin… or so you'd think! But there’s a tiny problem—Saki is a total germaphobe and can’t even bring herself to touch “that spot”!? Get ready for a ridiculous, perverted comedy about overcoming phobias in the most bizarre way!

(Source: Comic Growl)

title.native: 潔癖サキュバスは×××がお嫌い
title.romaji: Keppeki Succubus wa XXX ga Okirai

197372.description:
One day, on his way home from school, a boy is passing through the park as usual, when he's asked, "Wanna sniff my pussy?" It's a mysterious older lady and the cat she's sniffing. When he hears she's apparently homeless and living in the park... he feels sympathetic and brings the woman and cat home, where his grandmother tells him, "Well, you picked them up, so you better take responsibility."

So begins the boisterous and somewhat ecchi daily life of a boy, an older woman, and cats.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: おねえさんと猫を飼う
ニセドル ～将来をちかいあった幼馴染がアイドルになって遠くにいっちゃったので俺もアイドル（女装）になって追いかけます!～
title.romaji: Nisedol: Shourai wo Chikatta Osananajimi ga Idol ni Natte Touku ni Icchatta node Ore mo Idol (Josou) ni Natte Oikakemasu!

197374.description:
Mira, once hailed as the strongest assassin, dies with bitter regrets at the hands of her rival—a young knight. However, when she reopens her eyes, she finds herself reincarnated a year later as the daughter of a noble family, bearing the same name...!?

Determined to keep her past identity a secret, Mira tries to live a quiet, unnoticed life. But over time, she becomes intrigued by a way of living that's the complete opposite of her previous one—protecting others. With a newfound resolve, she sets her sights on becoming a soldier.

A thrilling reincarnation tale of a rule-breaking assassin girl rewriting her destiny!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: かつての暗殺者は来世で違う生き方をする
title.romaji: Katsute no Ansatsusha wa Raise de Chigau Ikikata wo Suru

197375.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 56 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of transformation.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

1. Cordinate Ranger (コーディネートレンジャー) [Kazune Yamamoto]
2. Hero Akane wa Miraretakunai (ヒーローアカネは見られたくない) [Hiroki Ishida]
3. Make-up Tomiko (メイクアップ・トミコ) [Misaki Araki]
4. Rumi-chan, Okoranaide (るみちゃん、怒らないで) [Mariko Kikuchi]
5. Taifuu Jack!! (台風ジャック!!) Kouhei Nishi
6. Anata no Amazon (あなたのアマゾン) [Ai Kobayashi
7. Yadokari to Yume no Sumiya (ヤドカリと夢のすみ家) [Hiroko Nagakura]
8. Tsuisou no Banka (追想の晩夏) [Kouhei Nishi]
9. Sayuri (さゆり) [Kiyoshi Katoh]
10. Aitei to Kitan (愛弟奇譚) [Sayaka Koide]
11. Awesome Summer Love! [Sayo Watanabe]
12. Uchi de no Kozuchi-kun! (うちでのこづちくん!) [Natsume Kishimoto]
13. Akuma to Kawarimi (悪魔と変わり身)
14. Uka Soudou (羽化騒動) [Iku Kamijima]
15. Tsume-ato ni Ai wo Komete (爪痕に愛をこめて) [Hirona Takahashi]
16. 18 [Akihito Tomi]

197376.description:
A booklet packaged with Fellows! volume 13 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of nonhuman characters.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197377.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 90 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of giants.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197378.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 17 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of beautiful boy.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197379.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 16 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of muscle enthusiasts.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197380.description: A booklet packaged with Harta volume 76 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of younger sister.

197381.description: A booklet packaged with Harta volume 74 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of younger brothers.

197382.description: A booklet packaged with Harta volume 75 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of older brothers.

197383.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 73 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of older sister.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197384.description:
Despite being a genius, the duke's daughter Liana is unable to earn her family's recognition. As such, she decides to run away. On her journey, she meets Fred, who seems to be just any other handsome adventurer. Sympathizing with her plight, he proposes they "become a couple"?! This is the tale of a genius girl seeking happiness, an isekai story of second chances!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 無自覚な天才少女は気付かない
title.romaji: Mujikaku na Tensai Shoujo wa Kizukanai

197385.description:
Yuichi Kayama, a reporter working at the JBK Torine branch of a nationally broadcasting television station, works hard every day to clear the name of his father, who died during an interview, and to become a true journalist. However, faced with the ever-changing state of the media, such as deference to power and reporting that hurts victims, Kayama decides to come up with a ``certain'' plan that will put his life on the line during a live broadcast one day...

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

197386.description:
Jang Baek-Hee is counting the days until he can escape Gicheon before his deadbeat father is released from prison. But then Yang Il-Woo arrives: a delinquent transfer student with a cheap perm, brassy hair, and a loneliness that mirrors Baek-Hee’s own. Slowly, their uneasy friendship deepens into something tender. But Il-Woo came to Gicheon with a secret that could shatter the fragile comfort they've both found in each other. And when the past comes calling, can two broken souls survive the truth?

(Source: Tapas)

197387.description:
Mari, the daughter of a servant, tries to save a child from a raging horse, but is saved by Hisame Saionji, known as the "Ice Captain." Mari is attracted to the captain, who is of a different social status, and when they meet again, Hisame proposes to Mari! But is there a reason for this marriage?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197388.description:
In the great nation of Sai, which reigns over the continent, there was a peerless beauty. Her name was Li Honglan.

"I'll cut off that man's head."

She was feared both at home and abroad as a ruthless empress. However, at the urging of a senior vassal, she has decided to take a husband. His partner is Wang Longyuan, the fifth prince of the vassal state of Shu.

"Let me tell you, there aren't many men who could become my husband."
"I'll never bow down to you of my own free will."

What seemed like a beautiful and well-matched wedding, but their back-and-forth exchanges have already created a turbulent atmosphere. What is Longyuan's secret? What is hidden in the harem? What will become of Honglan's fate?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197389.description:
After losing her parents, Makoto finds herself without a place to call home. She is given a temporary marriage to Chihiro, a young novelist. And what's more, their new home is an old folk house where youkai gather...?

The story of ayakashi and a contract couple, set in the ancient capital of Kamakura, begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: あやかし屋敷のまやかし夫婦　～契約夫婦は鎌倉で妖怪の集う家を守る～
title.romaji: Ayakashi Yashiki no Mayakashi Fuufu: Keiyaku Fuufu wa Kamakura de Youkai no Tsudou Ie wo Mamoru

197390.description:
Momiji, a daddy's girl, is beautiful but has no boyfriend, much to everyone's dismay. One day, she's attacked by a thug, but the man who rescues her is...?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197391.description:
Manga artist Tamiko Tsuneyoshi was captivated by Bali and moved there. But she has a secret side to her... She's the proprietress of an Edomae sushi restaurant!? In her pride and joy, the mother and daughter welcome guests from all over the world in their garden, filled with her beloved flowers and plants. This paradise is filled with irreplaceable happiness...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197392.description:
A touching omnibus of stories about cats, set in front of a train station late at night! Natsume always visits Yuucho, the cat who lives in the mailbox in front of the station. As Yuucho, a stray cat who isn't very friendly, slowly grows closer to Natsume, various stories unfold in front of the station...

A heartwarming collection of stories guaranteed to bring you to tears 200% of the time.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.romaji: Neko to Yozora no Shita de

title.native: 僕がお従姉ちゃんと先にセックスするはずだったのに…
title.romaji: Boku ga Ojuushi-chan to Saki ni Sex suru Hazu Datta no ni...

197394.description:
Natsune was dumped by her beloved ex-boyfriend, Tsubasa, for being too attached to him. Since then, she's decided to stay out of other people's lives and is enjoying a smooth relationship with her current boyfriend, Haruto. But something happens that threatens to shake up her peaceful days...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 私ってうざい？キモい？面倒くさい？

197395.description:
Mankind... This is what sex is...!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2023-12

197396.description:
30-year-old Seri is inherently unlucky, so much so that her intended husband was arrested for marriage fraud. When she returns home, she finds her mother has married for the fourth time and suddenly has a new father and a brother two years older than her. Seri flees to her grandmother's house, but her grandmother is away on a trip. One day, she returns to her grandmother's house to find her step-brother, Tatsuma, and the two of them end up living together...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 一生ひとりで生きていくと決めたのに血のつながらない兄が同居してきて困ってます
title.romaji: Isshou Hitori de Ikiteiku to Kimetanoni Chi no Tsunagaranai Ani ga Doukyo Shite Kite Komattemasu

title.native: 風紀を乱すは窓辺の君
title.romaji: Fuuki wo Midasu wa Madobe no Kimi

197398.description:
Hikari lives with her husband and newborn son. While her husband, Eita, was initially supportive of childcare, he gradually began to leave everything to Hikari. Reaching her limit as a single parent, Hikari asks Eita for help and decides to hire a housekeeper. But the housekeeper turns out to be the man she had a crush on back in her student days...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 孤育て～ひとり育児は限界です～
title.romaji: Kosodate: Hitori Ikuji wa Genkai desu

197399.description:
Two inexperienced lovers embark on a summer romance that's too innocent for words.

Kaisei Okitsu, a pure-hearted college student, falls in love with Taiyou Shiozaki, who is a year older and works at a beachside cafe. He starts part time job at the resort to follow him, only to find himself blushing at slightest touch. One night, Kaisei gets drunk and pushes Taiyou down, kissing him... before passing out! Kaisei convinces himself that it was all a dream. Meanwhile, Taiyo, who has noticed Kaisei's feelings, cannot stand the awkwardness and blurts out:

"Just say it already, do you like me?"

Taiyou finds Kaisei's feelings endearing and it makes him happy, but there's a reason he can't respond to his confession...

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 好きにするなら夏にして
title.romaji: Suki ni Suru Nara Natsu ni Shite

197400.description:
The talented and established actor Kazuki Toujou, meets a frivolous-looking young man named Rui Yukishiro at his favorite bar. They have few drinks together and hit it off more than he expected. Kazuki ends up taking care of Rui, who's completely drunk. But when they get to the hotel, Rui's attitude does a complete 180, Kazuki gets drugged and is forced into a one-night stand... A few days after that nightmare, Rui is introduced as the agency's new talent!? On top of that, he threatens to expose what happened unless Kazuki lets him live at his place.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197401.description:
One day, Futami had a dream in which her husband asked for a divorce. She thought it was just a dream, but on their fifth wedding anniversary, it became reality! As her dreams continued to come true, Futami realized she was having precognitive dreams. She enlisted the help of her coworker, Kuroshima, to track down her husband's affair partner, but then she dreamed that she was pregnant...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197402.description:
The strongest mage who can't hide his cheat begins the slow life he has longed for!

In his previous life, he died of exhaustion after a life as a corporate slave. After his reincarnation, he is revered as a hero for using his rare "plant magic" skill to end the war, but he is framed by his colleagues and expelled from the court.
