The village becomes more and more prosperous due to Lilit's unintentional cheats, and Lilit is visited by a flower girl, a cat girl, and even an imperial princess...?
synonyms: After being fired from the court, a plant mage enjoys a slow life.

title.native: 宮廷をクビになった植物魔導師はスローライフを謳歌する～のんびり世界樹を育てたら、最強領地ができました～
title.romaji: Kyuutei wo Kubi ni Natta Shokubutsu Madoushi wa Slow Life wo Ouka Suru: Nonbiri Sekaiju wo Sodatetara, Saikyou Ryouchi ga Dekimashita

197403.description:
Swordsmanship, magic, physical strength... Marco Pietala is a jack-of-all-trades who retired from fighting because he was unable to master any one skill. He was living a carefree, slow life with his wife, Oni, a Hobbit, until one day, their house was attacked by a beast... A fantasy about a man with low self-esteem who starts his adventure all over again!

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title.native: 器用貧乏おじさんの異世界再冒険
title.romaji: Kiyou Binbou Ojisan no Isekai Saibouken

197405.description:
Kohinata Nobara, a wealthy young lady, transfers to a high school near her home to become independent and live a new life! Everything outside is new and exciting! Her new school is full of the delinquents she's heard about...?!?!? On her first day at school, she's harassed by delinquents, but an even more flashy boy comes to her rescue...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 教えてください！　白州くん

197406.description:
1. Kimi ga Tsukeru Ai no Shirushi (君がつける愛のしるし)
2-3. Boku no Shiranai Koi no Hanashi (僕の知らない恋の話, Story of Love that I Do Not Know)
Continuation of Chapters 4 to 7 ofMokuyoubi no Koibito.
Arima loves Saeki, his wholesome and earnest lover with an enticing pheromone, but Saeki's ex is Arima's neighbor Tanaka. Saeki convinced Arima to dump Tanaka and date him instead. Meanwhile, Saeki still bears scars from the BDSM activities his ex-lover forced on him, and he feels uneasy every time Arima's is tender toward him...

(Source: Kobunsha)

4. Yoru, Kimi ni Ai ni Iku (夜、君に会いにいく)
Continuation of Chapter 1 of Yoru, Kimi no Ai wo Shiru.

5. Itsuka Sonno Hi ga (いつかそんな日が)
Continuation of Chapters 2 to 3 of Yoru, Kimi no Ai wo Shiru.

6. Saiteina Anata (最低なあなた)

title.english: Story of Love that I Do Not Know
title.romaji: Boku no Shiranai Koi no Hanashi

197407.description:

197408.description:
If you are chosen as the groom of the peerless beauty Venus, the splendor of this world will be yours to enjoy. However, not a single person has ever returned from boarding the special train that carries groom candidates, the Venus Express. In order to meet Venus, whom he fell in love with at first sight, Sabimaru drops out of high school and boards the Venus Express. With the help of Satetsu, a mysterious and unsociable man with exceptional skills, and Eustace, a handsome knight with a natural appetite, Sabimaru's incredible journey begins. A thrilling, full-scale adventure begins!!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

197409.description:
Natsukasa, the 52nd of the White Chain, infiltrates a French Foreign Legion fortress to investigate, and meets a company commander named Louis, who has a void in his eyes...? Satetsu and Eustace travel the world to retrieve the mysterious power left behind by Venus. The princesses continue to research languages while fighting against the Pure Lands, and the Yuezhi who protect them. And Sabimaru, who is raising a daughter with Venus. This is a collection of exquisite spin-off stories from the hugely popular series, depicting some untold stories from the century-old love story between Sabimaru and Venus, as well as the aftermath of their journey.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

197410.description:
Eight years after his journey on the Venus Express, Sabimaru leaves the management of his bar in Yokohama in the care of someone else and sets out on a journey to visit the people who helped him back then. He meets the nameless baby for the first time at the Tsukishi camp, builds a grave for Natsukusa's mother in a village in the Arctic Circle, and finally arrives in Granada, where he meets up with Sandetsu and Eustace, who had gone ahead of him, as well as his beloved daughter, Sakura. This journey is also a journey to teach Sakura, now seven years old, about her mother, Venus. What did Sakura see as she traveled the world away from her father for the first time?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title.native: 金星特急・番外篇 花を追う旅

197411.description:
Sakura grew up on Inuhebi Island, a remote island inhabited only by women. One day, when she turned 15, two mysterious men landed on the island. When one of the men spotted Sakura, he said with a big smile, "We've come to pick you up, Sakura." Introducing themselves as Mitsuki and Sunaetsu, they were associates of Sakura's father and seemed to know about her past, something that even Sakura herself didn't know. Sakura decided to leave the island with them to see a world she had never seen before, but...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

197412.description:
The current Emperor of the Doom Empire, Peregrin I, and his poison taster, Marcus. On their way back from a secret trip to the castle town to enjoy some "common" delicacies that aren't available at court, the two are attacked by someone. They fight back, but are chased by patrols, and the two instinctively jump into another "portal"...

You're sure to get hungry after reading this. A gourmet fantasy featuring a master-servant duo begins!!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

197417.description:
Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn’s life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197418.description:
We’re officially a married couple! They say marriage is one long, continuous conversation, but every moment feels brand new and surprisingly difficult. Still, we have to keep going, right? Whether we’re communicating through words or our bodies... we’re doing this the right way, aren't we? Explore the steamy, awkward, and heartwarming reality of a couple figuring out what it truly means to be husband and wife.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Is this what being newlyweds is really like?

197419.description:
20-year-old Choa ends a relationship after discovering her boyfriend mocking her for being bad in bed. Soon after, she learns her childhood friend and tutor, Seunghyeon, was dumped for the same reason. They decide to “study” together to rebuild their confidence, but these weekly “lessons” soon turn into something far hotter, and as bodies and boundaries blur, they must decide whether this chemistry stays in the bedroom or becomes something real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197420.description:
Matataburris is a girl who retrieves requested items from a polluted sea. People who have extended their lifespans through body mechanization seek her out to recover mementos left behind on the ocean floor.

(Source: Harta, translated)

197421.description:
After nine years in a stable relationship, Park Ah-jung is on the verge of marriage, yet quietly restless. Seeking a change in her hairstyle, she visits a new salon and meets Kang Jikdo, a dangerously alluring stylist.

Behind the ordinary facade lies a private VIP room where his demeanor shifts, and the air turns tense and intimate. There, she is met with a service she never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Wouldn’t you feel lucky if a busty hottie sat next to you on the overnight coach bus? What if that hottie was a freaky, pervy cosplayer who wants to have sex with you all night long!?

On her 20th birthday, her chastity and her life were left in pieces by her husband, and everything came to an end... or so she thought. In the blink of an eye, Elizabeth is unscathed, back to the moment just before she married?! And now her childhood friend who has become the Archduke is suddenly very passionate about her?!

197426.description:
Frémea is the saint of the kingdom of Justitia, which only comes along once every hundred years. As the kingdom's saint, she has very little freedom, and in the company of her faithful knight, Roland, she heals the people of all the evils that afflicts them. One day, there is a rumor that Fréméa is an usurper. She is then banished from the kingdom. However, a new life full of freedom is now open to her, along with her protector Roland, who is the only one to believe in the young woman.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197427.description:
Mai Sasaki, who lives in Tokyo, was supposed to end her life due to illness. However, just before she died, her grandmother bestowed her with magical knowledge and powers, and sent her off to another world. Now that she is healthy again, Mai resolves not to waste the life she has been given, and opens a cafe called "Hideout" at the end of the royal capital. Henry, the castle's top civil servant, who frequently visits Mai's "Hideout," seems to have a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197428.description:
Lured by the promise of 5,000 yen an hour, Tsuyoshi applies for a part-time job as a nanny for a foreign family. However, the young master in question, Bartholomew Wellington, nicknamed Babu, is 18 years older than him. He is intelligent and athletic, but he is also a total troublemaker known as "The Devil's Tail"! Tsuyoshi, a young and strong man, is chosen to overpower the young master, who has given previous nannies a hard time.

From that day on, Tsuyoshi's peaceful and steady life changes drastically...!? The absurd premise is depicted with undeniable persuasiveness!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Junta rushes to his great-grandmother's deathbed, but ends up participating in a "scam" game with his inheritance at stake. With his shady older cousin Kenji as his partner, Junta's life-changing summer vacation begins!

197431.description:
Takuto used to be a loser, but he completely turned his life around. Now he has a good looks, a great job, and a fiancee from a wealthy family. Unfortunately, his sexual needs aren’t really being met, and that leads him to spending a lot of time looking for women on social media. When he goes to meet his in-laws for the first time, he’s shocked to find one of the women he found online is actually his fiancee’s sister. Maybe she can help him find the release he needs…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 106, 108.

197432.description:
When Momo's foster grandfather suddenly passes away and she is left all alone, two men who claim to be her brothers appear before her. The two men are the sons of Momo's biological father, whose existence she had never even known. The eldest brother, Fuyuki, is very rich and kind, while the younger brother, Kai, is adopted and unsociable. Kai owes Fuyuki 800 million yen, and every Wednesday he becomes his slave, making him cook elaborate meals.

In order to get back the movie theater left to her by her grandfather, Momo applies for a loan, but...

Delicious food, masterpieces, and mystery. A cinematic mystery begins!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Pure… shrine maiden... gyarus!? This obscure shrine in the middle of nowhere is in need of some thick, sticky offerings to boost their visibility and boost the local population numbers. But even though the gyaru shrine maidens are supposedly pure virgins, they sure seem to enjoy having sex!

"I wish we could stay like this forever."

Blind finally realized that the feelings he'd had for Theo since the day he first met him were love, only to be confronted by the news of his marriage. Driven by guilt over wanting him and the desperation that he was his everything, Blind crumbles under Theo's relentless grasp. Then, news of his father's death arrives, a revelation that will change everything...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

197438.description:
Before her wedding, she visits a secluded summer cottage for bridal lessons. There, she begins her secret tutoring...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

197439.description:
“You took my virginity, so you better take responsibility.”

One night of drunken mistakes with her younger brother’s friend, and now Ji-Woo is completely trapped! Wait, weren't you always the quiet one? Weren't you the guy who had zero interest in women, let alone me? From acting out of character to suddenly playing the role of her "boyfriend," Seung-Hyun’s behavior is driving Ji-woo crazy. She’s realizing all too late—it only takes a single moment for your life to spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.

197440.description:
People start disappearing from the housing complex in 1984, between the period of high economic growth and the bubble economy. Kosuke moves into Hikarigahara Housing Complex with his childhood sweetheart, Ayako. The residents warmly welcome them and the two envision a happy new life together, but there are memories of a dark incident from the past...

A chilling Showa-era horror!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

197441.description:
By day, she's a smart office worker, and by night, she's a bestselling author of adult novels, unleashing her pent-up desires. She didn't want anyone to know she was an adult novelist, but the new team leader caught her.

"Mr. Gouri, let's do this."
"Huh?"
"Let's be partners."

This man keeps pushing her, offering to give her feedback on her novels... Even if she wants to refuse, she can't!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

197442.description:
Everyone has a story. What about the dead, especially? Here, there's a radio station that comforts them. Sky Blue Radio introduces the diverse stories of the deceased. Sky Blue Radio's DJ, Sky, grants their wishes in return for sharing their stories... The sad and cruel stories of the deceased with their diverse stories.

"What is your wish?"

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

197443.description:
High school student Yuki Miyamori has a favorite. That's the "number one hottie senior in the school," Renya Fuwa! This senior who is the spitting image of his beloved light novel character is a top student both in academics and sports. It's as if he lives his life with cheat codes activated. Yuki used to spend every day admiring him in secret. In spite of that...

"You'll be my pillow today too, okay?"

Renya pushes him down and explores the depths of his body with his long fingers, making him melt with pleasure...!

Read the heart-throbbing school life story of a playboy senior with insomnia and a geeky junior who is weak to the handsome face of his favorite!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The year 20XX, sexual punishment has been added to the punishment dealt to criminals. This is a story about said criminals who are shamed with public nudity and forced to perform sexual services with "ass in the wall" duty. Note: There are some expressions / depictions where the human rights of the criminals are practically non-existent

A bully gets his just deserves when the boy he bullied decides it's time for revenge. He is sold to a mysterious organization, restrained and then "stuck in the wall" with his ass in plain sight for all to see. Then the naughty games begin!

197454.description:
"Even if I'm clingy, I want to be loved!"

Noa is a fine arts student. While preparing for university entrance exams, he was dumped by his girlfriend, who also cheated on him. His "clingy" personality is the reason he gets dumped so quickly whenever he falls in love. All he wants is for someone to accept his twisted view of love.

Then one night, Yuki, a senior with broad shoulders, soft muscles, and a quiet, gentle aura, helps Noa, who has passed out drunk at a welcome party. For some reason, Noa is drawn to him and impulsively entrusts his heart to him but...?

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

197455.description:
Modern idol Airou has never been in love—or even acted in a romance. Cast opposite seasoned actor Sakiyama in a decadent period BL, he asks if he can truly fall for him to understand the role. As their on-screen romance grows increasingly intimate, Airou finds himself unable to separate acting from his feelings for the man behind the character.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

197456.description:
It was still cold spring in his senior year of high school. Shouma is reunited with his childhood friend Yohei for the first time in 11 years. There was a problem with the room he rented to live alone. They have a spare room at his house, and they end up living together. Under the same roof, they are always conscious of each other. Because Yohei was his first love.... This is a reunion love story that will make your heart throb with earnest and straightforward feelings!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197457.description:
"One person walks across an empty space, while another person watches." What is theater? Acting? How can you act someone else's life when you don't even understand yourself? You act because you don't understand. You act because you want to understand. A coming-of-age play brought to you by a team of writers and editors who have poured their passion into theater.

(Source: MangaONE, translated)

197458.description: "The Rabbit Who Couldn't Jump and the Island of Gods" is a boy-meets-girl story about a "big mystery on a tiny island." Reon, a middle school boy who moves to Tsukito Island, where his late mother was born, reunites with his childhood friend Wako, the daughter of the Shuto family, the island's richest family. Wako is a shrine maiden of the Shuto family who oversees the island's religious ceremonies, and has supernatural powers, allowing Reon to be amazed at her ability to fly through the sky. Reon hopes to take Wako, who grew up in the countryside and dreams of the city, to Tokyo one day, but Wako laments that as a shrine maiden, she cannot leave the island. The story begins when Reon, puzzled by her words, learns of a secret about the island and the shrine maiden.

title.native: 跳べないウサギと神の島
title.romaji: Tobenai Usagi to Kami no Shima

title.english: A Beast Can't Change Its Spots

197460.description:
There's always at least one person in every classroom... Everyone curses, but if you look closely, it's a story from our surroundings that's not like someone else's.

(Source: Naver, translated)

197461.description:
Tatsumi Azuma, a sociable third-year student at Keyaki High School, crashes into second-year Shunpei Eguchi and fractures his hand. But the stone-faced Shunpei is no ordinary student—rumor has it he'll kill anyone who so much as looks him in the eye! Afraid of retaliation, Tatsumi tells Shunpei he'll do anything to make up for his blunder. Thus, Shunpei puts him to work by making him help out at his family's bathhouse, Sakura-no-yu!

(Source: Yen Press)

197469.description:
“Even after losing her memories, it’s still Jin Kyudo… What a cruel connection…”

Jin Kyudo, in his attempt to start a new life, reunites with his long-lost lover Shin Danbi at the company where he has just been hired. While Kyudo is completely flustered, Danbi remains eerily calm. The truth is, an accident erased every bit of their past together from her memory. Not wanting to hurt her twice, Kyudo tries to distance himself. But Danbi keeps getting drawn to the warmth and strange familiarity she feels from this strange man. This way, a tangled romance unfolds. Kyudo struggles in his attempt to let go, Danbi refuses to, and Ahn Choi weaves herself between them like a thread in a messy knot. Into the empty space left by lost memories, new emotions slowly soak in.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

197470.description:
The true story of Japan's surrender in World War II and how it nearly didn't happen!

In the final days of World War II, Japan lay in ruins and the cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki had been obliterated. A tense drama unfolds in Tokyo as Japan teeters on the edge of Armageddon. Japan's Longest Day tells the true story of the day immediately before the surrender, as a group of fanatical army officers attempt to prevent the Emperor from surrendering—an act of high treason which will inevitably result in Japan's total annihilation.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)
synonyms: Japan's Longest Day: A Graphic Novel About the End of WWII: Intrigue, Treason and Emperor Hirohito's Fateful Decision to Surrender
14 août 1945 - Le jour le plus long du Japon

197471.description:
Yuuma, who had just entered university, had many things he wanted, but couldn't decide what kind of part-time job to do. At that time, Kurosawa, a problem child who had committed an act of violence soon after entering university asked him, “You wanna do some cleaning work?” Hearing that the hourly wage was good, Yuuma decided to accompany Kurosawa to work, but then...

The story depicts the work of a “night cleaner.”

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197472.description:
Crown Prince Ian and Priestess Rebecca were once in love, but for his happiness, she let him go. Yet on his wedding day, Ian is poisoned and dies in her arms. In despair, Rebecca sacrifices everything: her love, her life, her dignity, and even time itself to save him. She succeeds, only to be branded a traitor and executed. But as death closes in, she awakens… three years in the past. Except this time, everything seems different. Will she be able to defy fate and protect the man she loves, or will destiny claim them both again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Butler Kim is the leader of the virtual reality game "Metaria" and the guardian of two cats in real life. One day, a mysterious boss monster appears in the game and forces him to change his job to "Butler." Forced to serve the monster, Butler Kim discovers an unbelievable truth.

"Oh my... a cat has logged into the game?!"

His pet cat, Pichiu, has entered the game. But the shock doesn't end there. The "master" who chose Butler Kim as his butler and has been communicating with him is none other than Kalinas, the embodiment of darkness. He, who should be the center of this world, is trapped in the body of Pichiu, unable to do anything! Now, the butler's duty becomes clear: Butler Kim must carry out the dark mission in his stead. But does the incarnation's mission really matter to Butler Kim? Is he simply happy that he can embark on a fantasy adventure with Pichiu?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

197475.description:
The only child of a prestigious family. A precious son is born with a misfortune. The fortune-teller they found for their son is Ran-Hui, born with the so-called "fate of noble birth." At the age of fifteen, Ran-Hui becomes Baek-Hyun's fortune-teller, absorbing his misfortune with every fiber of her being. She grows weaker by the day, finally absorbing the last of the misfortune and dying in Baek-Hyun's lap. But what happened? Ran-Hui, who was clearly dead, has come back to life. Everything is thrown into disarray by the discovery that she, who should have died, is alive, and now Baek-Hyun's wife. And finally, she discovers the secret Baek-Hyun has been hiding...

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

197476.description:
A fantasy action webtoon inspired by the myths of the legendary island of Jeju.

After a great catastrophe, the world is divided into small tribes. Each tribe possesses mysterious individuals known as "Powerful Ones," who serve as both offensive and defensive forces for the tribe. For a long time, wars and conflicts between the tribes continued, but these Powerful Ones intervened and made a pact not to invade each other, leading to a period of lasting peace. A century later, a small tribe in the north proclaims itself the "Nation of the Herd," establishes a "nation," and begins subjugating other tribes by force. The tribes are colonized, and their children are taken away. These children undergo rigorous education and training to become "Fighters" of the Nation of the Herd, and are then deployed in battles to conquer the colony.

The Fighters subdue the Sanbu Tribe, which boasts two Powerful Ones, and swiftly defeats the surrounding tribes. During a battle with the Wild Tribe, they capture Garo, a boy with the potential for destruction, and Garo's mother, a Powerful One, and subdue the Wild Tribe. Mo-Hun, the youngest prince of the Land of the Herd and a warrior at the forefront of the conquest war, leads Garo and the Fighters on their quest to conquer the Island of the Beginning. Encountering storms and stranding, they eventually reach the Island of the Beginning, where they encounter the Prime Tribe. Living among these people, who have a completely different way of thinking and lifestyle, on the peaceful Island of the Beginning, Mo-Hun, the Fighters, and Garo gradually begin to change.

Meanwhile, the Land of the Herd succeeds in developing Ancient Power (Explosives), and Prince Kaitan heads to the Island of the Beginning with his army, carrying the explosives. Having set foot on the Island of the Beginning, they launch a war of aggression. The "Those Who Remember the History of the Gods (Simbang)" of the Beginning tribe summon "Gwanegitto (God)" and fight back. And Mo-Hun and the Fighters begin a battle to protect the Primordial Island and the Primordial Tribe against their homeland. On the Primordial Island, a fierce battle unfolds between empire and colony, technology and spirit, invasion and peace, competition and cooperation.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

197477.description:
Kyoka Suzui, the protagonist of "Suzui-san no Oshimeshi," is a high school girl who is crazy about supporting her idols. After a concert, she stops by a soba restaurant and is so impressed by a type of katsudon (pork cutlet bowl) that has the cutlet on top without being covered in egg that she decides to make it her "oshimeshi" (favorite meal) rather than her favorite idol. The story follows Suzui, who has awakened to her passion for food, as she encounters various "oshimeshi" (favorite meal) that satisfy both her stomach and her heart.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197479.description:
Sayuri, who was training hard with the dream of opening a Japanese sweets cafe, is suddenly summoned to another world one day. However, at the same time, another "Saint" is summoned, and she is told that Sayuri's existence was a mistake... Will she be able to fulfill her dream in an unfamiliar world, while also using her hidden powers to save it?! A love story of cross-cultural exchange!

(Source: MangaOne, translated)

title.native: 巻き添えで異世界に喚び出されたので、世界観無視して和菓子作ります
title.romaji: Makizoe de Isekai ni Yobidasareta node, Sekai-kan Mushi Shite Wagashi Tsukurimasu

title.native: 居候同期に触れられたい
甘え上手で、愛され下手の。
title.romaji: Amae Jouzu de, Aisare Heta no.

197482.description:
Office worker Mochizuki leads an average, ordinary life in the countryside—and that's just the way he likes it. Besides the mundanities of his daily routine, not much out of the ordinary happens to Mochizuki... until the day his former classmate—the man who turned his world upside down—shows up at his workplace.

Natsuki Hyuga has been infatuated with Mochizuki ever since they were in school together, but Mochizuki always avoided his advances... until now. Now that they've been reunited, Hyuga is determined to finally take their relationship from colleagues to lovers, but Mochizuki can't imagine why someone so extraordinary would want to be with someone so... ordinary.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)
synonyms: 不起眼的我有個異常後輩

title.english: A Boring Man and an Extraordinary Man
title.native: 冴えない俺の異常な後輩
title.romaji: Saenai Ore no Ijou na Kouhai

title.native: 求婚(プロポーズ)は計画的に

197484.description:
Eiji Honami is a dependable manga editor—and the unwilling emotional support human for his bestselling author and childhood friend, Kaede Mishima. Mishima can’t possibly finish a manuscript unless Honami visits three times a week. Deadlines, breakups, existential crises—somehow, they all require Honami’s presence (and snacks). But Mishima’s attachment runs deeper than Honami realizes, and every now and then while Honami sleeps, Mishima indulges in some very questionable... “inspiration.” Honami remains blissfully unaware of just how deep his author’s obsession runs... until the day Mishima decides to make his feelings known.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: 修羅場のワンサイドラブ

synonyms: Prince of Dawn and Cursed Sage

title.native: 暁の皇子と呪われた賢者
title.romaji: Akatsuki no Ouji to Norowareta Kenja

197486.description:
The game of push and pull between an arrogant demon and a meek, gloomy boy!

Raine gets overly obsessed with the things he loves. As a result, he doesn't have even a single friend! But that's not a problem for our little Raine! If he doesn't have any friends, he'll just have to make them. Raine's idea is to summon a cute little demon to be friends with! But what appears is something far from cute...a large, sturdy build and an arrogance that matches his grand stature...the demon, Luchatra! If he doesn't fulfill his contract—to become friends with this human—he'll be sent straight back to the demon realm. But unfortunately, our cocky demon doesn't know the first thing about being friends...so he jumps to the only thing he knows—kissing and touching the innocent Raine!

Will Raine finally make his first friend? Or will the demon he summoned actually end up being something even more?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 君はあくまで友達です！
title.romaji: Kimi wa Akuma de Tomodachi desu!

197489.description:
Are you sure? Do you really want me to stop now?

Kanata Kisaragi is an editor who began working at a publishing company due to his love for picture books. But when he transfers from the children's books department to the literature department, he's put in charge of convincing Itsuki Sakuraba, the notoriously fastidious illustrator, to collaborate on a project. When Kanata is ordered to tidy up the reference materials at Sakuraba's office one day, Kanata accidentally gets aroused. Without a second thought, Sakuraba reaches into Kanata's pants and makes expert use of his hands to help give him that sweet release, not forgetting to steal a few kisses along the way. The next day, Sakuraba returns to being his usual grumpy self, which only confuses Kanata further. Thus begins a sweet romance between a pure-hearted, endearingly unaware editor, and an irritable artist who becomes enamored by him.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 完璧な柴先輩のやわいとこ
title.romaji: Kanpeki na Shiba Senpai no Yawai Toko

197492.description:
"Bocchan, Komarimasu!" tells the story of Toru, a high school boy with the appearance of a beautiful young girl, the son of a wealthy family, and Nanami, a beautiful, handsome woman who works as his bodyguard. Toru is a feminine boy but has the personality of an old man, and gazes at Nanami's beautiful body, saying, "She has a sexy body, it's the best, ooohhh," but his love is genuine and he hopes to marry her someday. However, Nanami, the bodyguard, does not approve of her having personal feelings for Toru, and despite being attracted to him, she suppresses her feelings and works hard at her job. The story depicts the relationship between Toru, who sends him passionate love calls, and Nanami, who has complicated feelings about him.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄された魔法薬師は炎の騎士に溺愛される～ただ幸せに、なりたかった～
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Sareta Mahouyakushi wa Honoo no Kishi ni Dekiai Sareru: Tada Shiawase ni, Naritakatta

197494.description:
Popular novelist Isatora Motobu fell in love at first sight with Shinobu, the successor to the long-standing traditional sweets shop Kamijo. Motobu's the type to passionately hone in on his target once he's set his eyes on them, and this time is no exception. But to his surprise, Shinobu doesn't resist when he invites him over and brings him to the bedroom. Conflicted between feelings of obsession, and displeasure over Shinobu's seeming experience with men, what's Motobu to do?! A steamy, yet candy-sweet romance between a hunky writer who loves to lavish his affection, and the alluring, refined young man he meets.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197495.description:
Note:
- Chapters 1 and 2 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 鬼上司は無能な部下にお仕置きされたい
title.romaji: Oni Joushi wa Munou na Buka ni Oshioki Saretai

title.native: 漢極道・環さんは愛されたい

synonyms: Itsuwari Omega wa Kyouken Alpha ni Aisareru
The Mad Dog Ω Loves the Flase Ω

title.native: 偽りΩは狂犬αに愛される
title.romaji: Itsuwari Ω wa Kyouken α ni Aisareru

197498.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Okyubou na Dear: Shinkon-hen (おくびょうなディア 新婚編, My Dear Insecure Lover: Newlyweds)" and one extra chapter.

title.english: My Dear Disgruntled Lover: Mr. Sakuraba's Peculiar Struggle
title.native: ふきげんなディア 桜庭先生の稀有な悩み
title.romaji: Fukigen na Dear: Sakuraba-sensei no Keuna Nayami

title.native: おくびょうなディア 百武先生の贅沢な悩み
title.romaji: Okubyou na Dear: Motobu-sensei no Zeitakuna Nayami

197500.description:
Ella, who has been reincarnated as Cinderella, dreams of falling in love with a prince. However, before that can happen, she must undergo training from a certain wizard...?!

(Source: Cheese!, machine translated)

title.native: 転生シンデレラはガラスの靴を履きたくない
title.romaji: Tensei Cinderella wa Glass no Kutsu wo Hakitakunai

197501.description:
The people wish for the execution of the royal family!

After being involved in a traffic accident on the way to school, he died, having never truly lived. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself reincarnated into the world of the novel, "The Tale of the Kingdom of Dawn," where men can marry and even bear children. Not only that, he's now in the body of the 6-year-old Prince Arkfeld, the future villain who's destined to be executed by his former fiancé?!

Surrounded by his doting guardian knight and equally doting older brothers, Arkfeld resolves to change his fate. He's determined to rewrite the story and claim his happy ending!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Reincarnated in Another World! The Bad Boy Prince Is Pampered by His Guardian Knight!!
title.native: 異世界転生！悪役王子は護衛騎士に溺愛される!!
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei!: Akuyaku Ouji wa Goei Kishi ni Dekiai Sareru!!

197504.description: Twelve Alien destroyers turned into meteorites and hit the earth, bringing an unknown zombie virus and setting off a doomsday frenzy. The evolution zone has opened, and power user has started to emerge! Wang Zhe, who died in battle ten years later, has reborn and returned back in time. Now he decided to use the advantages of his memory and strength to become the strongest evolutionary!
synonyms: Random Evolution In Doomsday: The Evolution

title.romaji: Kimi no Tonari de Nemuru Wake

197507.description: The Fan clan, which possesses the ability to borrow powers from ghosts, had its succession ceremony interrupted by an accident. Everything began to spiral out of control...

title.native: 人のものをすぐ貰おうとする後輩
title.romaji: Hito no Mono wo Sugu Moraou to Suru Kouhai

title.native: 陰キャパパ活ゆーなちゃん 中出し生ハメにハマる♥
title.romaji: InCha PapaKatsu Yuuna-chan Nakadashi Nama Hame ni Hamaru

197512.description:
"Even a clam wants a little bit of action!"

Aoi's a college student out with his friends digging for clams. After walking a bit off from the regular digging spot, Aoi finds a larger asari clam that pops open... and out comes a gorgeous looking young man!

"Let's have sex... now."

What? Aoi is now stuck as a mate to this Asari clam being, and they start living together... but out of nowhere comes another shellfish named Mirugai, and a super kinky marine biologist...! What's going to happen with all of them in the same room?!

"Asari... I'm gonna c-...!!"

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Notes: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: From the End of a Life Form

197514.description:
Jayden, a renowned thief, was always on the lookout for a better life in his line of work, which involved acquiring people’s wealth. One fateful day, he had an unexpected encounter with Ian, a person well-known for their popularity and beloved by the masses.

In the course of his activities, Jayden received an assignment to burglarize a house, but to his surprise, the house he targeted belonged to Ian, and he stumbled upon an adult video.
synonyms: ブラック・ウォッチ〜暗闇で交差する視線〜

197515.description:
The most powerful cultivator of the immortal realm has descended to the city. He will beat down the Japanese snake, defeat the Western pantheon, restore spiritual power with a snap of his fingers, and open the gate to heaven with a wave of his hand! Those who looked down on me in the past will now kneel and beg for forgiveness!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: My Teacher Is a Rebirthed Immortal 2

title.native: 修仙归来在校园 第二季
title.romaji: Xiu Xian Gui Lai Zai Xiao Yuan Di Er Ji

synonyms: That I of a very popular actor appear on AV

title.native: 国宝級イケメン俳優の俺がAVに出るなんて
title.romaji: Kokuhou-kyuu Ikemen Haiyuu no Ore ga AV ni Deru Nante

197518.description:
Each day, Rihito confesses to Arata, and their relationship begins anew. At the end of each day, Arata forgets.

One year ago, a strange comet passed over Earth, leaving countless individuals with inexplicable memory loss... One such individual was Arata. Not only did he lose his memories of falling in love with his childhood friend, but also the ability to make new ones. Unwilling to give up hope, Rihito logs each day they spend together by the sea and refuses to leave Arata's side—even if it means abandoning his own future. When each new day dawns with hope and ends with heartbreak, how many days can a forgotten love endure...?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

synonyms: The paradise is in our hands

title.romaji: Rakuen wa Te no Naka ni

197521.description:
Hanayo spends her days as a Zashiki-warashi watching over young Kotetsu. However, one day an accident leaves Kotetsu without a home. Determined to protect him, Hanayo is shocked when Kotetsu chooses his new home to be... in Germany, and in a share house! Just how much of this house is her home? Plus, foreign countries have their own ayakashi crawling all over! Kotetsu begins pursuing a new career as a picture book author in Germany, and the ayakashi, though from different worlds, live together under one roof. Everyday life in this share house is full of happenings and surprises!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 不死を求める者、これを道士と呼ぶ
title.romaji: Fushi wo Motomeru Mono, Kore wo Doushi to Yobu

title.native: 彼女の未来と僕の架空現実
title.romaji: Kanojo no Mirai to Boku no Kakuu Genjitsu

197524.description: The top gaming livestreamer suddenly wakes up as a powerless Demon Lord with zero combat ability! Want to unlock cheat powers? First, he has to defeat his own subordinates. But with no strength — not even enough to beat a chicken — how can he turn the tables and survive in this brutal world?
synonyms: Reborn as a Doomed Demon Lord? But I'm a Full-Strategy Streamer!

title.native: 穿成炮灰魔尊？但我是全攻略主播
title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Paohui Mo Zun? Dan Wo Shi Quan Gonglüe Zhubo

title.native: 八尺様とコロポックル

197526.description:
Dependable older sister Izumi and her energetic younger sister Rakko are close siblings. As Izumi's birthday approaches, the excited Rakko seems to be plotting various ways to make her sister happy, but…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197527.description:
Having been betrayed by her scumbag boyfriend, Zoey Nan impulsively made a move on Hugo Fu, the tycoon of the business world. Her ex witnessed it all, yet could only boil with rage, powerless to act due to his fear of Hugo Fu’s status. Zoey had thought this was merely a mutually beneficial deal. But as workplace crises piled up and her ex-boyfriend made relentless advances, she found herself cornered at every turn. The man who'd promised to keep things purely physical and emotionless kept coming to her rescue, shielding her with extreme protectiveness. What began as a game of revenge gradually spiraled out of control...

(Source: WebComics)

197528.description:
Byeong-Gwan, who hates being bored, got a job in the security department of a college and started peeping girls through CCTV. One day, he sees a cowardly girl getting naked in public.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

synonyms: Hooking Up with My Exes Again!?

title.native: 元カノたちとヤReなおし！？

197531.description: The story follows Caesar, the pet dog of Ryosuke Kagami (nicknamed “Erosuke”). Famous as the most charming “ikemen dog,” Caesar suddenly gains the ability to take human form. This unexpected transformation throws him into a series of wild, chaotic situations involving women, while also dragging in Kyur, a partner bound to him by a shinigami contract. Packed with slapstick humor and risqué antics, the series shows Caesar swept up by desires and troubles that Ryosuke himself knows nothing about.

title.native: だから僕は、Hができない。〜カエサルの煩悩〜
title.romaji: Dakara Boku wa, H ga Dekinai.: Caesar no Bonnou

title.native: フィクションの外で待ち合わせ

197535.description:
Arisa works part-time as a sexual slatherer for her uncle. Today is not the appointed day, but she has come to her uncle's house for her own convenience, saying she has no money. Even though it is sexual relief, there is a rule that "penetration is prohibited", but her uncle asks for sex in exchange for special treatment... Starting with foreplay sex, Arisa's day at work sees her switching roles, using her breasts and mouth.

(Source: Fanza, translated)
synonyms: A Niece Who Works Part-Time at Her Uncle's House

title.native: 姪は叔父宅でバイトする
title.romaji: Mei wa Oji Taku de Baito Suru

197536.description:
Black Britain, a land rich in gems and minerals. Su-Wol, a goldsmith who has been secretly in love with Seo-Hwa, a merchant from the merchant class, since childhood, is finally determined to convey his long-held feelings to her. However, while Seo-Hwa's merchant class is sailing upstream carrying trade goods, it is attacked by Gwisu, losing the goods and suffering enormous losses. Seo-Hwa receives a marriage proposal from her trading partner, Ji-Il, in exchange for preventing the merchant class's bankruptcy. Su-Wol sets out to defeat Gwisu, the mastermind behind the incident, and recover the lost goods, determined to prevent both the merchant class's bankruptcy and Seo-Hwa's marriage. Will Su-Wol be able to resolve everything and convey his feelings to Seo-Hwa?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197537.description:
Nao is staying over at his aunt's place to take a university entrance exam, but he's so nervous he can't sleep! Luckily, Aunt Rika knows just the trick to calm him down.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: My Married Aunt Took My Virginity
title.native: 入試前日人妻の叔母に筆おろしされた
title.romaji: Nyuushi Zenjitsu Hitozuma no Oba ni Fudeoroshi Sareta

197539.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Kimi no Suki ni Shitsukete (君の好きに躾けて)" previously published in Fall in Heat: Verse BL Anthology (Fall in Heat バースBLアンソロジー) Volume 1, and two extra chapters.

197540.description:
Eun-gil Gong’s used to seeing her name in the news. As volleyball’s problem child, she’s seen it all, but the world discussing her upcoming marriage to Hahyeon Seo, eldest son of JaeKyung and owner of her former team, is another matter... Especially since Hahyeon only offered the contract marriage to clean up the rumors about Mina—his sister and Eun-gil’s only fan—being gay. Between the money and helping Mina, it was easy to accept, but one question remains: What’s he getting out of this?

(Source: Tapas)

197541.description:
Angelica, a princess who grew up in the slums and was treated poorly, is ordered to marry for political reasons. Her partner is Abel, the first prince of the imperial kingdom, who is feared as a "mother killer." However, in reality, he is a surly but kind-hearted, beautiful boy! With no backing, Abel is driven into a corner as nobles who are vying for the right to inherit the throne try to kill him, but the two join forces to pull off a brilliant reversal! A thrilling reversal story and a Cinderella romance!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 薔薇姫と氷皇子の波乱なる結婚
title.romaji: Bara-hime to Koori Ouji no Harannaru Kekkon

197542.description:
The twenty-year-old girl thought her bedridden life had ended. But the next moment, she was reincarnated as Renese, the villainess in her favorite R-rated romance novel. In the novel, the heroine, Aria, and the hero, Prince Frantz have a fateful encounter and fall for each other. Frantz's fiancee, Renese, tries to break them up by using Elden, her knight. Elden is also in love with Aria and betrays Renese in the end. She decides to change the story this time so that Elden, her favorite character, can be together with Aria. First, she must avoid the "love potion event" which happened when Aria accidentally spilled a love potion on Frantz. However, the potion was spilled over Elden! And somehow he starts pursuing Renese passionately...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 惚れ薬イベントが私に起きてしまいました
title.romaji: Horegusuri Event ga Watashi no Okite Shimaimashita

197544.description:
Sleep, wake up, eat, watch videos, then head to his part-time job at the izakaya. Aoi has been living these unremarkable days, but recently, he’s found himself looking forward to seeing a certain customer: serious-looking man who always comes in alone for a drink. There’s nothing particularly special about him, yet Aoi can’t help but follow him with his eyes. One day, he sees this guy, who normally drinks so neatly, unusually chugging his drinks only to end up passed out under the eaves of the shop. Not entirely without ulterior motives... Aoi ends up taking care of him and bringing him back to his place—?

(Source: Cmoa Comics, tranlsated)

197545.description:
Takamatsu is a college student working part-time at a video rental shop. He starts falling for his cool older coworker, Mano-san... A sweet yet agonizing love story about a guy punching above his weight in romance!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 真野さんは宇宙みたいだ
今日から僕は、彼女の✕✕を解消する。
title.romaji: Kyou kara Boku wa, Kanojo no ✕✕ wo Kaishou Suru.

197547.description:
Mei, a 20-year-old university student, is heartbroken and enters into an arranged marriage. Her partner is a cold, uncaring older man... What will happen to their newlywed life?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

197548.description: The sequel to the smash hit "Nurse no Chikara"

197549.description:
Saichi runs a small restaurant called Mitsuhara. One day, an elementary school student comes to his restaurant alone, which is unusual. The child, who has come without telling his parents, is harboring a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

197550.description:
Tang Mujin, a young physician hailing from the Tang Family Clinic of Sichuan, had a strange dream... one where he became the legendary blacksmith Ou Yezi and ascended to the heavens.

(Source: Naver, translated)

197551.description:
Beyond the Wall, survival is never guaranteed. In a world where mutation can turn anyone into a monster, Margo and Esther make a living taking on jobs no one else will. Margo fights to keep her hunger under control, while Esther clings to the belief that she was born from love. But as they draw closer to the truth, buried memories begin to surface, and the line between human and monster starts to disappear. Esther was everything Margo had ever loved. But will everything be tested when they finally learn what they are to each other?

(Source: WEBTOON)

197552.description:
Ji-Han Han, a normal university student who lived an ordinary life, got into a work accident and already said goodbye to his life, but suddenly he got a chance from an unknown god to resurrect in another world!

"Can I see the level and skills?"

"Use your skills to level up. Distribute stats and use items."

"Am I in another world as a playable character?"

 Ji-Han Han came to the fantasy world with the powers of a playable character. Now he will play under the name of Rudin in another world!

(Source: Naver, translated)

197553.description:
Hitomi, who works as a staff member at a major junior high school entrance exam prep school, is shocked by the brutal reality of the exam process. Grades even determine class and seating, creating stress for children. Hitomi struggles to help these children who suffer under the pressure of their parents' egos and ideals, but...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 偏差値の悪魔～その中学受験、本当に子どものためですか？～
title.romaji: Hensachi no Akuma: Sono Chuugaku Juken, Hontou ni Kodomo no Tame desu ka?

197554.description:
Akari and Saku are a couple in a slump. While living together, they end up taking care of Saku's niece, Eri. Will Eri, a motherly elementary school student, help or worsen their relationship?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197555.description:
Yuka, a former gyaru and office lady in her 40s, is hit by a truck. When she regains consciousness, she's reincarnated as a vibrant 19-year-old girl!? And with a handsome husband! Her perfect second life begins now...or not. It turns out she's living in a hellish house with an abusive husband and a bullying mother-in-law...?

Use your gyaru power to completely defeat the abusers in a refreshingly new way! A new kind of in-law battle!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197635.description:
Shizu, who married into an inn in Shinagawa-juku, was frustrated that she wasn't allowed to be involved in the inn's business. At that time, the advance party of the Satsuma daimyo, Akamatsu, came to inspect the inn, causing chaos for everyone at the inn. Meanwhile, Akamatsu mistakes Shizu for a prostitute and rapes her. Dazed by the cock that is far larger than her husband's, Shizu begins to move her hips aggressively, thinking that she can be of use to the inn if she satisfies Akamatsu.

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Go Ranshin Vol.3

title.native: お役に立ちとうございます
オタギャルカノジョができた理由-陽の章-
title.romaji: Ota-Gal Kanojo ga Dekita Riyuu: You no Shou

197637.description:
Lee Seung-Hwa, a transfer student, arrives in the quiet rural village of Guam-ri. He beats class president Woo Ho-Young without warning and announces to his classmates: "Woo Ho-Young's father, Woo Sang-Cheol, is a murderer who killed two people, including his own father." With everyone turning their backs on him, Woo Ho-Young meets someone who understands him and begins to heal his wounded heart.

(Source: Naver, translated)

synonyms: What If Your Subordinate Knows Your Secret?
If My Subordinate Finds Out About My Secret Alt Account

title.native: 部下にヒミツ(#裏アカ)を知られたら

197639.description:
In this tough job market, you have to overcome your lack of qualifications, academic background, and connections to get a job.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

197640.description:
Han Seong-Min was born into the cult "Jinchon Church" and lived there his entire life. He eventually lost everything and escaped alone. Years later, as an adult, he infiltrates the cult again and embarks on a brutal revenge.

"Oh, my leader. I will send you. To the Lord you love so much."

(Source: Naver, translated)

197641.description:
1. Kinniku Shoubu Shimasen ka (筋肉勝負しませんか); Comic Anthurium 2022-12
2. Osananajimi no Mune ga Dekai Ken ni Tsuite (幼馴染の胸がデカい件について); Comic G-Es 5
3. Himegoto Camp (秘め事キャンプ); Comic Anthurium 2021-10
4. Tonari no Ecchi na Galko-chan (隣のえっちなギャル子ちゃん); Comic Anthurium 2020-06
5. Cosplayer Senpai no Himitsu! (コスプレイヤー先輩の秘密っ!); Comic Anthurium 2019-10
6-8. Biyoushi-san wa Boku Shimei? (美容師さんは僕指名?); Comiket 101, 103, 105
9. Senpai! Motto Ore ni Gohoubi Kudasai! (先輩!もっと俺にご褒美ください!); Comiket 97
