幼馴染の胸がデカい件について
隣のえっちなギャル子ちゃん
コスプレイヤー先輩の秘密っ!
Senpai! Motto Ore ni Gohoubi Kudasai!
先輩!もっと俺にご褒美ください!

197642.description:
Coming from a single-parent family, Seo-An yearned for a complete family. While the journey wasn't smooth, she strived to build one while raising her adorable daughter, Su-Eun. However, Seo-An, who yearned for the most complete family, encountered the most imperfect of beings...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: いやらしいのはキミのせい
title.romaji: Iyarashii no wa Kimi no Sei

197645.description:
Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Koi wa Camera no Uragawa de (恋はカメラの裏側で)".
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I have fallen in love for the boss who looks up.
Koi wa Camera no Uragawa de

title.native: 理想の上司とする恋は
title.romaji: Risou no Joushi to Suru Koi wa

197646.description: Note: Published in Charles Mag vol. 9 Erokyun.

197648.description:
A slightly mysterious and just right collection of short stories!!

A grown-up Zashiki Warashi, a cold-sensitive Yukio... there are "non-humans" who are harmless to humans and animals, living modestly in human society. This is a hilarious omnibus from Oda Tobira, the author of "Danchi Tomoo"!

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

197649.description:
Lodina is a commoner woman brought before the Margrave Dilmique from the neighboring kingdom for marriage. The two do not share much in common but pay no mind as this is a contractual marriage agreed upon in coin! Everything's for the money! Lodina had a tough time in both her past life and present life, which is exactly why she's willing to be with whoever it is in this contractual marriage along as the coin comes flowing in. However, the man standing before her with a mask to hide his "grotesque" face turns out to be an absolute charmer?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: A Gold Digger Commoner's Contractual Marriage With an Insecure Noble Turns Into Mutual Devotion
title.native: お金が大好きな平民の私は卑屈貴族と契約結婚して愛し愛されます
title.romaji: Okane ga Daisuki na Heimin no Watashi wa Hikutsu Kizoku to Keiyaku Kekkon Shite Aishi Aisaremasu

197650.description:
Infidelity, betrayal, lies, violence. Others say to leave it to the law, to forgive, that anger produces nothing. Is that really true? A modern-day tale of women's revenge begins...

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

197651.description: Note: Published in B’s-LOVEY recottia May 2012 issue.

197652.description:
Includes two stories:
1. #Junjou to wa (＃純情とは, #Pure Love is...)
2. #Tanjoubi no Ou-sama (＃誕生日の王様)

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 50.
synonyms: 「ヒーリングパラドックス」番外編同人誌
ヒーリングパラドックス deeper 番外編
「ヒーリングパラドックス」番外編 同人

197655.description:
While exploring the Demon King’s old castle, ordinary soldier Lunovs unexpectedly encounters the Demon King.

The Demon King falls for him at first sight and immediately takes him back to the castle.
Mistaking the situation for a plan to eat him, Lunovs is terrified...but instead, he finds himself showered with affection from morning to night!?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Notes:
- Chapters 1 and 8 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

197656.description:
After quitting his job as a nursery teacher due to being an omega, Chiaki begins working for a housekeeping service company.

At the end of the year, he is suddenly dispatched to the home of an alpha with children. There, he is greeted by three kids aged seven, six, and two, as well as the hybrid alpha Ookami.

With his massive frame covered in gray-brown fur and his stern demeanor, he is like a wolf incarnate. While worrying about the unapproachable Ookami, Chiaki starts living in as a housekeeper, but from that very night, a bittersweet and strange change begins to affect his body!?

(Source: Futami Shobou, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: オオカミパパに溺愛されています

197657.description:
Of all the guys to fall for, I never thought it would be someone like you...!

Gorgeous, talented Rei is the heir to and manager of a major cosmetic brand. Despite his domineering personality and the rumors of scandal that hound him nonstop, he doesn’t have the slightest experience to speak of when it comes to love! In fact, he’s spent his life waiting to find his hero, the ideal partner he dreamed of as a kid. One day, in order to protect Rei from stalkers, his father hires him a bodyguard named Ichijo—who, under his serious, straitlaced exterior, is exactly Rei’s type! When they’re forced to be together around the clock, Rei’s heart won’t stop pounding...but he never could have suspected the ulterior motive Ichijo holds...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 高嶺の花には欲がある
title.romaji: Takane no Hana ni wa Yoku ga Aru

197658.description:
I never knew the weight of the words "I'll protect you." I hated the fact my father said he'd protect us but left. I despised those words. But I never knew I'd be saying the same thing, to none other than the daughter of the jerk who killed my dad.

(Source: TOPTOON)

197659.description:
Notes:
- Originally self-published, was then later licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
- Chapters 1 to 5 were split into two parts in the original release on Pixiv and Twitter, and later combined in the volume release.

title.native: フレンドリーな取り立て屋さん
子持ちホストの欲張りな隣人
title.romaji: Komochi Host no Yokubari na Rinjin

197661.description:
Yet another man falls prey to Yuki's carefully crafted facade. There's only one characteristic he seeks in his partners... a similarity to his first love. Yuki's more than willing to admit that, too. When his provocation's about to turn into a fight, a handsome man valiantly steps between them.

The two are brought together by fate, but Yuki soon realizes there's a secret he must keep. What does the future hold for a disillusioned office worker and a hustler who overcomplicates his first love?

A story about two unfulfilled and misunderstood first loves that bloom into new adoration!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: トンでもない俺のα－ナダと菫人－
トンでもない俺のα－シノと空－
Tondemonai Ore no α: Nada to Sumito
Tondemonai Ore no α: Shino to Sora

197665.description:
She comes to my sweets shop every day demanding manju. What's the secret she's hiding behind her mild demeanor?

(Source: Harta, translated)

Note: An award-winning one-shot in the second Yatagarasu Cup.

197666.description:
Estabrica is a town adventurers flock to. In this busy town, city hall worker Nada has lost his purpose in his busy everyday life, until one day when a wolf cub comes to his workplace...

(Source: Harta, translated)

Note: An award-winning one-shot in the first Yatagarasu Cup.

title.native: こちら、エスタブリカ市役所です。

197667.description:
I, Rana Yamada, am a plain, unremarkable, "invisible" high school girl.

Even when I try to create something, nothing ever comes of it, and I’ve resigned myself to always being a background character. Then, one spring day during my senior year, Shion Kagesa, a super-popular voice actress whose voice sounds like mine, suddenly finds me! She tells me, “There’s something that only you can do…”

“Will you switch places with me?”

Me, an amateur, replacing Shion as a voice actress!? That's absolutely impossible... But I find myself wanting to try it. The thought that “my voice” is needed made my heart race. Diving into the thrilling world of anime production disguised as Saion, I discover that there are roles only someone "invisible" like me can play—!

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

title.native: 午後４時。透明、ときどき声優
軽率にBLしたら彼氏ができました
title.romaji: Keisotsu ni BL Shitara Kareshi ga Dekimashita

title.native: 地雷なオマエと恋なんて
title.romaji: Jirai na Omae to Koi Nante

197670.description:
Based on Patrick Lafcadio Hearn's 1904 Novel "Kaidan" dealing with japanese ghost stories.

1. Haru no Shou: Chawan no Naka/In a Cup of Tea (春の章「茶わんの中」)
2. Natsu no Shou: Miminashi Houicihi/The Story of Mimi-Nashi-Hoichi (夏の章「耳なし芳一」)
3. Aki no Shou: Rokuro Kubi (秋の章「ろくろ首」)
4. Fuyu no Shou: Yuki-onna (冬の章「雪女」)

197672.description:
"She has a secret. It's a secret that only I know..."

My childhood friend Yuika is a beautiful girl with long black hair, popular with the other students at school. Today, a boy confessed his feelings for her. But she won't go out with him. No, she can't exactly go out with anyone. Because of that "thing" attached to her...

That "thing" made it hard for Yuika to live a normal life, having to constantly worrying about other people finding out.

But her worries are in the past. Now Yuika and I have a secret routine that frees her from that "thing."

This is the story of how that secret routine began.

I'm the only one who knows about her secret "thing."
I'm the only one who can set Yuika free.

(Source: Prestige Comics, translated)
synonyms: It Looks Like This and It Grows.

title.native: こう見えて生えてます。

197673.description:
The demons took his farmhouse, his wife, his peace. Now Vincent Burns lives to kill as many as he can. The excommunicated exorcist, along with Sister Beatrice and local sheriff Chloe, has found himself in the middle of a demonic plot to bring Hell itself to the United States, yet the biggest puzzle is the white-haired girl he found in a suitcase. Demons not only die upon biting her; flowers bloom from her wounds. Vincent and Beatrice must keep her safe until they know her purpose, while Chloe must keep her sanity against the demon horde.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197674.description:
Moon-Pyeong Seok, a lowly grunt of the Demonic Sect, never expected to be dragged into the deadly struggle to choose the next cult leader. Tasked with guarding the terrifying Heavenly Demon himself, he’s caught in a dangerous mission far above his station.

(Source: Manta)

197675.description: Five years into our marriage. No children. Separate bedrooms. Everyday life feels dull. One day, my husband brought home a present. He said it was a gift from one of his subordinates. I used to love exchanging presents, so I started looking for a suitable return gift...

197676.description:
The mother goddess Mut, who abandoned his position as a god and fled to the human world to escape his adoptive son, Montu, who was strangely obsessed with him, faced strange desires directed at him in the human world he fled to. Mut, once a perfect god, fell deeper and deeper into the swamp, and memories of his son, Montu, began to strangle him...

"Won't the time come when even you, mother, will understand how painful hunger is? Sooner than you think."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Editor's Note: This comic contains content that may cause mental or physical violence, forced sex, blood, or other unethical/traumatic content.

197677.description:
One day, Jeong-Woo can't sleep because he sees a ghost that appears every morning at 3 a.m. and bites his fingernails. Tormented by sleep deprivation and fear, Jeong-Woo tries to figure out when this phenomenon began, and is reminded of an incident that occurred after a drinking party with his childhood friend, Hee-Won.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

197678.description:
I dedicate this chastity to the hero! An otherworldly harem adventure story where the protagonist, Ota, is unrivaled with his erotic skills. He is reincarnated in a doomsday kingdom that is about to be attacked by a horde of monsters and destroyed in six days. Ota has acquired the cheat skill "Emperor of Sex," which gives him a huge amount of experience points depending on his erotic experiences. He tries to avoid destruction by having sex with heroines of various professions and races, but...

(Source: Big Comics, translated)
synonyms: The Harem of a Nation that Will Perish in Six Days

title.native: あと6日で滅びる崖っぷち国家のハーレムに召喚されてしまった
title.romaji: Ato 6-ika de Horobiru Gakeppuchi Kokka no Harem ni Shoukan Sarete Shimattan

title.native: 性芯注入 オレっ娘嬌声指導

197680.description:
Emeline is the only direct descendant of the Margrave of Garrett, whose powerful magic protects the boundary between the monster and human worlds. However, for some reason, she lacks magical powers. Because of this, it is her duty to marry Damien, who possesses strong magical powers, and have children with him. However, Damien is a man who constantly threatens to break off their engagement and belittles Emeline. Her only emotional support is Emeline's personal bodyguard, Bart, and her maid, Alma. Bart secretly has feelings for Emeline, who continues to endure unreasonable treatment out of a sense of responsibility. Even if their feelings are reciprocated, the two are in a relationship that can never be together! A love fantasy about broken engagements and differences in social status!

(Source: Young Champion Web, translated)

title.native: 無能と蔑まれた令嬢は婚約破棄され、辺境の聖女と呼ばれる～傲慢な婚約者を捨て、護衛騎士と幸せになります～
title.romaji: Munou to Sagesumareta Reijou wa Konyaku Hakisare, Henkyou no Seijo to Yobareru: Gouman na Konyakusha wo Sute, Goei Kishi to Shiawase ni Narimasu

197681.description:
Wouldn't you like to get chills at the Ghost Story Club?

A spine-chilling ghost story begins. This is the prefecture's only ghost story club, "Shinen." Our most popular ghost storyteller, Shion, will once again bring you some exquisite stories tonight... Rumored to have psychic powers, she will tell you a host of terrifying stories...! Enjoy this new type of horror that depicts the fears lurking in everyday life!

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

title.romaji: Yoru no Chou wa Ayashiku Kataru

197682.description:
In the Vermilion Kingdom, only fighting ability is valued. Prince Grace, the youngest brother, possesses only the useless skill "World Library," which has nothing to do with military or magical power, so he is appointed as the lord of the remote land of Asgard... or rather, he is banished. Arriving in the "farthest wasteland" with his childhood friend, a magic swordsman, and an understanding dwarf blacksmith, Grace discovers something incredible!!!

(Source: Suiyoubi no Sirius, translated)

title.native: 外れスキル「世界図書館」による異世界の知識と始める『産業革命』 ～ファイアーアロー？ うるせえ、こっちはライフルだ!!～
title.romaji: Hazure Skill "Sekai Toshokan" ni Yoru Isekai no Chishiki to Hajimeru "Sangyou Kakumei": Fire Arrow? Urusee, Kocchi wa Rifle da!!

197683.description:
Yomi Kanade, a university student, is a smart guy.
That's how others see him, and that's how he sees himself.
His life is smooth sailing.

That's what Yomi thought, until he meets Kenichi Hamano, a fellow student from another department. It all started when Kenichi picked up Yomi's cell phone, which he had dropped at a drinking party, and returned it to him. Thinking Kenichi seemed nice, Yomi invites him into his home.

“Can you help me with my assignment?”

During a comfortable moment, Hamano asks Yomi to appear in his photography project. The theme of the assignment is “love.”

“Oh, so that's what this is.”
With that cold realization, Yōmi refuses Hamano's request—but... ?

What is “love”? What does it mean to “like” someone?
A story about the vivid changes of the heart during the moratorium of college life.

A cynical, resourceful, poor college student × a demi-sexual, innocent genius.

A faintly sweet slice-of-life BL.

(Source: Daisy Comics, translated)

197684.description:
Lin Jia-Ling, who looks just 17, is actually in her thirties and has decided to go back to school to finally get her A-levels. In addition to her evening classes, she also works as a maid in a mysterious castle. The young master of the castle is always shouting that he wants to marry Jia-Ling. Unexpectedly, he is in fact the real master of the castle and, incidentally, a vampire over a thousand years old!

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

197685.description:
The year is 2013. Japan, which is facing a serious problem of declining birthrates and an aging population, has established a Ministry of Marriage and developed a national marriage app that allows people to find compatible partners based on genetics, personality, etc. Reon, heartbroken after her best friend seduces her boyfriend, decides to sign up for the Ministry of Marriage app, but..

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 負けヒロインですが結婚します～この中に私の夫がいる!?～
title.romaji: Make Heroine desu ga Kekkon Shimasu: Kono Naka ni Watashi no Otto ga Iru!?

197686.description:
Forty years before Koxinga, a silent revolt is brewing in Formosa against the East India Company and its Dutch governor.

(Source: Nazca, translated)

197687.description:
Dánavodan, the leader of the Stone Dragon Knights, is loved by all the members of the order...and even more so, he is showered with favoritism. As his daughter, Meinir, worries about the strange situation surrounding her father, a wizard appears before her...!?

(Source: Hana Yume Ai, translated)

197688.description:
At the end of the 17th century, the Dutch East India Company extended its influence across half the globe, leaving a bloody trail wherever it encountered resistance. However, in 1661, a force arrived in the south of the paradise island of Formosa (the Dutch name for Taiwan). Frederick Coyett, the last Dutch governor of Taiwan, faced 25,000 Chinese soldiers. Across the battle lines from him stood Koxinga, the young Ming loyalist and son of a pirate who would eventually found his own kingdom in Taiwan. Tempers flared and blood was shed as a war for resources turned into a struggle for self-determination and liberation from oppression.

(Source: Nazca, translated)

197689.description:
Yumeko is a high school girl who posts "egg character manga" that are going viral on social media. Yumeko dreams of drawing a yankee manga, but spends her days submitting entries for newcomer awards only to be rejected. One day, she gets involved with a yankee senior, Miyamoto Ryuji, and her daily life begins to change...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ヤン女は竜の夢をみる
title.romaji: Yanjo wa Ryuu no Yume wo Miru

197690.description:
The events of this story take place at an indeterminate time in the future. Masashi is a young man who administers an illegal waste disposal facility. When he salvages a special prototype android that was about to be disposed of under suspicious circumstances, little does he realize that life as he knew it would be changed forever...

Notes:
- Includes the one shot GEOFRONT BASEBALL GAME
- Includes the one shot Easy Cutter (イージーカッター)

197691.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 62

title.native: 幼馴染ギャルは唐突に
ありがちな魔王と勇者

197693.description:
Passionate police officer × petite office lady.
A heart-stirring dramatic TL.

(Source: Minty, translated)

Note: Continuation of the serialization under a new publisher.

title.native: 続・その警察官、ときどき野獣！～鍛えたカラダに守られ＆襲われる絶倫生活～
title.romaji: Zoku Sono Keisatsukan, Tokidoki Yajuu! Kitaeta Karada ni Mamorare & Osowareru Zetsurin Seikatsu

197694.description: The epic action masterpiece that delved into human nature, Rebirth - The Lunatic Taker, returns with its full-color finale! The story of siblings Reiji Tachibana and Ayaka Tachibana continues with even more dazzling action and an enhanced story.

197697.description:
In the Fight Empire, where strength and beauty were valued above all else, even the princesses led armies and spent their days in battle. This is a story of one particular day in the lives of two princesses born into this nation.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: A Day in the Lives of Two Princesses

197700.description:
Jiro Kusunoki had always admired Yoshiyuki Kurihara from afar, drawn in by his slender frame and his big, beautiful eyes. Jiro joins the track and field team in order to get closer to his crush, but finds it difficult to keep up, as Kurihara always runs alone to isolate himself from others. Jiro perseveres, however, and the distance between them slowly starts to fade away…

(Source: Juné)

Note: Published in Magazine BE×BOY 1994-09

197702.description:
Our married life began the day my husband was resurrected... Aiko, the eldest daughter of the Nijo household, is oppressed by her family. One day, in the midst of her modest life, she suddenly receives a marriage proposal, and wonders if this is perhaps her chance to find happiness. However, this is short-lived when Aiko arrives at the wedding ceremony to see a coffin containing her husband-to-be, Shotaro. Much to her surprise, it had been arranged for Aiko to marry the deceased in a "ghost marriage." Just as she resolves to live her life mourning Shotaro, she hears a voice say, "What is this place...?" When she looks next to her, Shotaro, who is supposed to be dead, is sitting up in his coffin!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Wed to the Dead: Bound by a Ghost Marriage, Drawn to Love
title.native: 棺の花嫁～冥婚により、二人は遠からず愛を知る
title.romaji: Hitsugi no Hanayome: Meikon ni Yori, Futari wa Toukarazu Ai wo Shiru

197704.description:
In order to hide the fact that they actually dislike each other, they end up living together while showering each other with compliments!

Suie, the daughter of a greengrocer, and Jun, a veterinarian, have known each other since childhood but have never gotten along with each other. When they find out that their parents are considering an arranged marriage for them, they lie and say that they are “already dating” in order to hold off the arranged marriage. But that is just the beginning of a fake romantic relationship that will leave them blushing with embarrassment!

(Source: eBookJapan, translated)

title.native: キライなアイツの褒めどころ

197705.description:
Koutarou's childhood friend Te-chan invites him to his home. Koutarou thinks it's weird since they haven't hung out together in years, but the carnage at Te-chan's home sends the boys running away together. Is Te-chan really bad? If so, why doesn't Koutarou leave him?

Note: Published in Magazine ZERO Winter 1995 [1995-01-20]

197707.description:
Notes:
- Ran for seven chapters in the original serialization and was compressed into six chapters upon volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: プラトニックシュガープレイ

197709.description:
Let’s laugh together, stumble a little along the way, and slowly, enjoyably, turn our “friendship” into “love”.

Souta had been living in a share house with a few part-time job friends since his student days, but one by one they moved out to chase their dreams or get married. Before he knew it, the only ones left were Souta and Ryou, who happened to be the same age. When Souta clung to him, whining, "I'm lonely! Don’t leave me too~" Ryou confessed: "I won't. I like you, you know." Wait, what kind of “like” is that?! Souta is confused, but…

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I love you and welcome home

197710.description:
A respected teacher stumbles upon the corpse of his ex-lover whose handsome young friend suspects him of foul play.

Published in Magazine BE×BOY 2003-07

synonyms: It's what you'd call, Oh my god

title.native: 残業特別手当はご入用ですか?
title.romaji: Zangyou Tokubetsu Teate wa Goiriyou desu ka?

synonyms: イ尓好（ニイハオ）マンション605

197719.description: Serafina, the daughter of a viscount, has been scorned as useless by her family and had her fiancé stolen by her own sister. One day, as she tries to forget her pain by devoting herself to her beloved embroidery, she receives a marriage proposal from Alexis, the "Ice Count," who is rumored to be cold and ruthless. "A wife in name only is enough. There's no need for us to share a bed," he tells her. Serafina is surprised by Alexis's request for a 'white marriage,' but her eyes immediately light up when he adds, "If you agree, I'll prepare an embroidery room for you." Thus begins a frustratingly sweet romance that starts with a contract marriage.

title.native: お針子令嬢と氷の伯爵の白い結婚
title.romaji: Ohariko Reijou to Koori no Hakushaku no Shiroi Kekkon

title.native: 召喚され令嬢の贅沢な成り上がり離宮計画〜光の手で満喫したら王太子が溺愛してくる〜
title.romaji: Shoukansare Reijou no Zeitakuna Nariagari Rikyuu Keikaku: Hikari no Te de Mankitsu Shitara Ou Taishi ga Dekiai Shite Kuru

title.native: 黒澤くんは照れたくない

197722.description:
Chu Mu, a young man from the Chu family, encounters betrayal from his soul pet, leading to his family’s downfall. Pursued by enemies, he is captured and bound to Nightmare Island, forced to serve as a slave feeding the terrifying White Nightmare within him. Any misstep could result in his soul being devoured with no burial ground. To survive and seek revenge, Chu Mu must grow stronger.

Fortunately, Chu Mu forms a contract with a mutated Moonlight Fox soul pet, naming it Mo Ye. With Nightmare Island as his starting point, Chu Mu will script the tale of the strongest soul pet master.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

197723.description:
This sounds like a thrilling dystopian saga where a cataclysm turns the world into a wasteland. Some people find refuge in fortresses, others hide in the wilderness, and some transform into different beings due to radiation. The world is divided into two extremes: the elite possess advanced technology, using fortresses to isolate themselves from the chaos.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: スペースノンフィクション

197726.description:
Who would ever believe a cat could talk? All I did was vent a little frustration to a stray cat on the street, but then...

[This is a reward reserved only for kind humans! Quick, tell me! Is that your wish, meow?]

"I mean, if it were me, I would’ve done it like this! I would’ve...!"

[Done! I shall grant your wish, meow!]

Suddenly, I’ve been transmigrated into my favorite novel—ten years after its ending! But since I’m here, I might as well live happily ever after with my "bias"! Will she be able to claim her happy ending?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Pure Romance Anthology] After Completion, with the Sub Male Lead
After the End, With the Sub Male Lead
After the Ending, I Healed the Supporting Character's Heart

title.english: Happily Ever After with the Second Male Lead

197727.description:
This is an important record of me, a crybaby, and you, like the sun.

Nohara Mio and Sonomura Shin have been childhood friends since elementary school, living next door to each other. In contrast to shy Mio, who is not good at socializing, Shin has many friends and is popular with the opposite sex. Mio has always had feelings for Shin that are more than just friendship, but he keeps them hidden deep in his heart and does not confess them. After a certain point, Shin's memory loss becomes more severe. In fact, he has been suffering from an illness caused by an old injury. Shin gradually loses his memory, and Mio supports him. Travel, love, photography... What will be the end result of this relationship that is woven together while misunderstanding, hurting, and struggling...? This is a story that depicts the ten years of two childhood friends.

(Source: Third Line Next, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197728.description:
Ara, a two-body goblin who transforms into a human when recited. Out of curiosity, the scheming Ja-Gyeong keeps summoning Ara...

What will Ja-Gyeong do with this goblin he's come into possession of? What exactly is this thing used for?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

197729.description:
The day of Hae-Seo's interview spirals into disaster—soaked in coffee, harassed, his ex on the panel, and some sleazy, too. He only wanted a fresh start, but instead, he collides with Gong-Woo. Marked by an Alpha before he can settle in, he now has to decide if he'll spend the night with Gong-Woo to undo the mark!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: This Is Not What I Joined For

title.english: This Isn't What I Signed Up For

197730.description:
Woo-Jin, who realized his past life during the Monster Gate incident, was a Cheonma who conquered the Central Plains! Even as a Cheonma, he had a dream he couldn't fulfill... so this time, he will definitely achieve it. That dream of becoming a chef! The great(?) story of the former Cheonma, Cheon Woo-Jin, on his journey to become a chef!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Wants to Be a Chef

197732.description:
Is the hand that heals the incurable a miracle, or a curse? Detective Lee Chang loses his family overnight in an accident. His only remaining family member is Chae-Rin, who inherited his sister's rare disease. Ten years ago, he visits the Cheonryong Church, the place that performed the miracle of healing his sister, but the cult leader, his last hope, is found dead.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.

197734.description:
Heo Woo-Dae, the slacker of slackers, always running away, turning a blind eye, making excuses, and blaming others. At the age of 42, he's lost his fortune in coin business, fired from his job, and about to be kicked out of his home. He travels back in time to meet his former lover, Jo Ah-Young, now a super-popular writer. Will he be able to become her husband?

(Source: Naver, translated)

197736.description:
Kim Hoon, a lowlife who makes a living as a part-timer soliciting loans for the illegal lending company Myeongdong Capital, also happens to be the lover of Ms. Bae, the daughter of the chairman of Myeongdong Capital. Then one day, Mrs. Bae asks him to pick up her son, Bae Je-Ah, from school. Kim Hoon, who thoughtlessly goes to pick Je-Ah up, receives an unexpected offer from him...

(Source: Naver, translated)

197737.description:
Notes:
- Released at Comiket 102, 104, 105, 106.
- A Recopilatory Volume for this series, titled "Gachihame SEX Shidou Soushuuhen", that includes a newly drawn chapter, was published on Feb 22, 2026 at COMITA155.

197738.description:
Utao Hananoi is a student at a prestigious academy—that’s meant for vampires! As a human, she must keep her identity a secret as humans are still considered food for the supernatural beings. But despite her best attempts, her secret is discovered by Shirotae… the progenitor of vampires! Thankfully, Shirotae offers to keep Utao’s secret, for now. Will Utao be able to keep her secret and her life or does Shirotae have other ideas in mind?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 好きだからって、奪ってごめん

197741.description:
An Ultimate Showdown Between an Introvert and an Extrovert.

Ai Xu, a designer of trendy toys, suffers from extreme social anxiety and despises socializing and teamwork. Once she became an adult, she did her best to find a job where 90% of the time, she only has to be accountable to herself. However, there is one drawback to being a designer for original IP: She still has to attend and speak at a weekly team meeting. Thankfully, she could simply play a presentation without saying much. Today, however, she was paired with the beautiful and dazzling extrovert Zhiyi from marketing to work as partners on a project.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

197742.description:
A hundred thousand years ago, the patriarch of the Forgotten Immortal Sect, Chen Xuan, was unrivaled under the heavens but chose to retreat at his peak. No one knew that he did so because his system enhancement, the golden finger, had malfunctioned and he could no longer make any progress. Concerned that he might not maintain his strength, he chose to live in seclusion. One day, a female disciple of the sect came seeking help, allowing the system to successfully reboot... As long as he continues to cultivate the juniors, he can continue to become stronger, and to make unilateral decisions for all eternity! The Profound Heavenly Emperor, who had been hiding for a hundred thousand years, has now emerged with a brand new golden finger...

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: 十万年ぶりのレベルアップ
Ẩn Cư Mười Vạn Năm, Hậu Thế Mời Ta Xuống Núi

title.native: 隐居十万年，后代请我出山
title.romaji: Yinju Shiwan Nian, Houdai Qing Wo Chushan

197744.description:
Urahara Ura meets Gyao, who was climbing the school building, when she starts high school. Intrigued by Gyao's words, "Climbing makes you feel awesome", Urahara decides to try bouldering.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

197745.description:
With her best interests at heart, Ethan decides to let his first love, Ruellie, wed his faithful knight, Zenon. However, on the day she is set to travel and meet her betrothed's family, tragedy strikes and she is found unconscious with her fiancé having gone missing. Ethan saves Ruellie, but upon waking up finds that not only did she lose her memories, she thinks Ethan is her fiancé! Will he be able to right these wrongs by recovering Ruellie's memories and finding Zenon?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Pour ton bonheur et rien d'autre
君の幸せにすべてを捧ぐ
ขอเพียงความสวัสดี จงมีแด่เธอ

197746.description:
"Everything you see and hear here must be kept a secret."

Chi-Seong receives an offer to handle chores at a billionaire's secret pool party. He heads to the vacation house, hoping to build connections with the elite. But he soon gets caught up in some trouble as he encounters a series of unexpected events and temptations.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

197747.description:
I became an evil.. and I decided to find and kill the people who made me who I am today.

(Source: DAYcomics)

197748.description:
“Please let this crush crash and burn!”

A romance story with a female lead who doesn’t want her unrequited love to come true?! Cho-Hui is on a mission to sabotage her own unrequited love. But when Shi-Ho discovers her secret, he blackmails her into making a deal with him. As if that weren't enough, I-Tae uncovers Shi-Ho's own unrequited love, turning everything into a tangled mess. Welcome to the story of a chaotic love triangle, where three people do everything they can to ruin each other's unrequited love!

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: เพราะรักมักร้าย

197750.description:
One day, Min-Ho’s world collapses, starting with his high school. When grotesque creatures descend upon Songcheon, the citizens are left helpless against their overwhelming violence and power. Worse still, the government abandons the city entirely, declaring that Songcheon must be sacrificed to protect the rest of humanity. With no rescue coming and danger closing in from every direction, Minho and his friends are forced to fight for survival in an apocalyptic city where the deadly creatures aren’t the only thing they can’t trust.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197751.description:
Yuki and Kaneda are childhood friends, neighbours, and more, but Yuki never seems to have time for Kaneda.

Note: Published in Junk! BOY Summer 2001

197752.description:
1. Mata Itsuka Soko Toki Made (またいつかその時まで)
2. Kanojo no Koto wo, Ikko Dake (彼女のことを、いっこだけ)

17. Suzuki-san (鈴木さん)
18. Yoru no Hitokake (夜のひとかけ)
19. Shiawase ni Nemuru (幸せに眠る)

197753.description:
Nananan Kiriko: Mishuuroku Sakuhinshuu is fans' long-awaited new release after a 13-year hiatus. Volume one compiles short stories and illustrations created from her debut in 1993 through the late 1990s. The second volume includes short stories and illustrations drawn after 2000, as well as the long-form work, High Time.

(Source: Tokyo News Tsuushinsha, translated)

title.native: 魚喃キリコ 未収録作品集
俺をイライラさせないでくれ准教授

197756.description:
Ning Yi, a modern-day doctor, traverses into the universe of a novel and becomes the vicious female supporting character who dies in the plot. Forced by a system that ensures she acts in accordance with the story to her death, Ning Yi then finds that only by getting near Prince Ning, the villain of the fiction, will she be able to escape the monitoring of the system. That leaves her with no choice but to follow him around.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Villain's Thigh I Firmly Held On

197757.description:
An accident gave an ordinary boy, Ye Han, the magical power to see through practically anything, and his life has become colorful since then. He has built the strongest business empire, dominated the world of gambling, raised people from the dead with his medical skills and became a divine physician and a billionaire, which made beautiful girls fall for him. However, a shocking plot and secret is going to hit him...

(Source: WebComics)

197758.description:
Lin Xianting manages a struggling restaurant and lives a mundane life without any grand dreams. However, his life takes a turn as he gets entangled in a war between gods and demons, resulting in him becoming a non-human, non-demonic entity. Human food can no longer sustain his existence, and the only food that he can consume is those processed with peculiar ingredients infused with spiritual energy...

(Source: WebComics)

197759.description:
As a wealthy heir, his last wish was to beat the game, and he did. When he opens his eyes again, he finds himself in that game, where he will be rewarded with the money he's previously spent on the game.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The King of Microtransactions Conquers the Game World
The Pay-to-Win King Conquers the Game World

title.english: Buying My Way to the Top
title.native: 課金王者がゲーム世界を制覇する
title.romaji: Ka Kaneousha ga Game Sekai wo Seihasuru

197760.description:
One drunken night, I thought I finally slept with Ko Woon-Ha, the person I’ve quietly loved for years. At least… that’s what I believed.

“Was it really you? Please tell me it wasn’t…”

“If not me, then who were you expecting?”

Turns out, it wasn’t Woon-Ha at all! It was his younger brother, Ko San. Ko San, the walking disaster. The charming troublemaker. The human hurricane who makes me want to strangle him every time he smirks. The more I try to escape his orbit, the more tangled up I get... like he’s pulling me into his chaos without even trying. Was that night really just an accident? Or is Ko San deliberately keeping me within arm’s reach? One thing’s for sure. Whatever this is, it’s not going to be simple…and I can’t even look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197761.description:
Isu Jin’s seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge… It’s to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197763.description:
Wait... No, you can't suck there...! Daughter of a famous movie production company's CEO, Towa, is a prominent figure at her Universtity. One day, she happens to bump into an unsuspecting delinquent of a boy on the street. "Show me how sorry you are. With your body". While these words were used to intimidate Towa, who actually thought she would do exaclty that?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: He is a crybaby and sometimes an extreme sadist

title.english: A Crybaby by Day a Sadist by Night

197764.description:
At our high school graduation, the rival who had tangled with me for years suddenly confessed that he liked me. It was completely different from the victory I imagined, but still, I thought I had won. I walked away believing the score between us was finally settled. That is, until years later, when he reappeared with a small child clinging to his hand. A son. Disgust and irritation flare up all at once. A shameless fool… If his heart was going to waver that easily, why did he confess in the first place? But fine. It doesn’t matter anymore. The past, his choices, the kid—none of it changes what I already know. If I wanted to drag him back into my bed, it would be the easiest thing in the world.

In this bitter, twisted reunion, the line between victory and desire grows dangerously thin.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: The Secret to Winning Over Unrequited Love
How to Win Over a One-Sided Love, Victory Is Mine
สูตรเผด็จศึกรักข้างเดียว

title.english: How to Win over Your Crush

197765.description:
Gae-Hwa, an evil spirit who pretended to be the lord of the ancestral home, was born. However, his peaceful days were shattered when the eldest son, Yu-Hyeon, destroyed the lord's altar. Faced with the threat of being defeated by Yu-Hyeon, Gae-Hwa lies, saying he can only ascend to the throne if he resolves his grudge.

"What grudge is yours?"

"...that you died without ever having sex?"

Yu-Hyeon then offers to help Gae-Hwa, and begins touching him "there."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

197766.description:
The villainess who almost destroyed her kingdom found herself looped back to five years before her death. She is a fourteen-year old girl, loved by her father, the King, and her two brothers. Sophia remembers everything that she had done, to her maids, to her knights, to her family. Bryath, her bodyguard, was loyal to her until he dies at war that she and her brother Riley started. She decides to save everyone including her, in this life.

Everyone was aghast when Sophia told them she'll start studying for the kingdom. She is determined to be a real princess for people, not villainess, in this life. Now she must uncover all conspiracies to avoid the tragedy. But something is off about Bryath... he is too protective in this life!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Tale of the Ravishing Villainess's Royal Second Chance at Life
title.native: 傾国悪女のやり直し王女譚 騎士団長が不器用で離れません
title.romaji: Keikoku Akujo no Yarinaoshi Oujotan: Kichi Danchou ga Bukiyou de Hanaremasen

title.native: ハンドレッドノート-ホークアイズ-
夜を教えて千夜来くん

197769.description:
A collection of six short stories, ranging from “A Country Called America,” a one-shot manga that reads like a journal of a trip to a fictitious America, to “A Long Stay”, which follows the inner changes undergone by J, a man who lives a quiet life in an isolated environment, when a mysterious woman N suddenly appears. Drawn with simple lines, these unique works leave themselves open to each reader's interpretation.

Note: Released at COMITIA 117.

1. America to Iu Kuni (アメリカという国, A Country Called America)
2. Nagai Taizai (長い滞在, A Long Stay)
3. Pepe-san (ぺぺさん)
4. Mansion wa Kansei Shimashita. (マンションは完成しました。)
5. Transformers (とらんすふぉーまーず)
6. America no Tsubo (アメリカの壺)
synonyms: Byu's Short Stories: All So Far Away

title.native: ビュー短編集　全部遠くにあった
title.romaji: Byuu Tanpenshuu: Zenbu Tooku ni Atta

197770.description: Joker is a genetically engineered shape-and-gender-shifter, who created as part of a Special Police Task Force and fights crime of all kinds.

197773.description:
After being cast out of the royal palace, three court ladies find themselves at the mercy of the streets. With nowhere left to turn, they seek refuge at a high-end brothel run by the legendary former courtesan, Seo Hakgeum. Among them, Yeoni and Solmae immediately draw every eye in the house, not just for their beauty, but for their untouched innocence. While the shy Yeoni hesitates, Solmae decides to embrace their new reality, awakening to her own desires as she takes the lead. In a world where beauty is currency, these former palace flowers must learn to bloom in the dark.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 酒幕のヨニ～春を売る女たち～

197774.description:
During the middle years of the Shang Dynasty, the nation's power gradually declined. A struggle for supremacy within the royal family sparked the "Nine Generations of Chaos." As the second son of the incumbent Emperor Zu Ding, Pan Geng was forced into this struggle for royal power, burdened with false charges and driven into exile...

(Source: Yiben Manhua, translated)

197775.description:
When the apocalypse hit, the protagonist was betrayed and killed by his manipulative girlfriend, only to be miraculously reborn one year before the end times with a powerful system at his fingertips! Getting a head start, he hoards supplies and spends a fortune building an impenetrable safe haven. Using his system to continuously boost his strength, he systematically crushes every enemy from his past life. From worthless nobody to ultimate powerhouse, revenge and redemption go hand in hand as he walks the path to becoming the king of the apocalypse!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Rebirth in the End Times: I Reached the Top by Opening Boxes
Rebirth in the Apocalypse: Rising to Power Through Loot Boxes
終末転生：報酬アイテムで世界最強へ

title.english: Rebirth in the Apocalypse: Rising to Power Through Blind Boxes
title.native: 末世重生：我靠开箱子问鼎巅峰
title.romaji: Moshi Chongsheng: Wokao Kai Xiangzi Wending Dianfeng

197776.description:
For unknown reasons, Xiao Zheng would transform into a tentacle monster when he became excited. Even if he longed for love, he would disguise himself as being cold. But suddenly he was summoned by Bai Anan, who was usually serious but secretly loved drawing. He signed an agreement and became Bai Anan’s “familiar”. He was threatened to help her – to draw the Manhua that would top the list!

(Source: Bilibli Comics, translated)
synonyms: After Turning into C-Type Tentacle Monsters, They Became Even Crazier
Turning into a Tentacle Monster, Made Me Crazier
After Transforming Into Lovecraftian Tentacle Monsters, They Became Even Crazier!

title.native: 变成克系触手怪后，她们更疯狂了!
title.romaji: Biancheng Ke Xi Chushou Guai Hou, Tamen Geng Fengkuangle!

197777.description:
After enrolling in a prestigious academy filled with alphas, Kureta, spends his days hiding he is omega, while overdosing on inhibitors. When he was unwell due to the side effects of inhibitors, he was helped by the handsome and popular Inukai-senpai, and he was attracted to his sweet and good smell. After that, Kureta started spending time with his senior, and thought that the distance between him and Inukai had narrowed, but one word from his senior's mouth shocked Kureta...

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: 秘匿のΩは運命を殺す ～ほどけた糸を結びなおして～
Hitoku no Omega wa Unmei wo Korosu: Hodoketa Ito wo Musubi Naoshite

title.romaji: Hitoku no Ω wa Unmei wo Korosu

197778.description:
Lu Li, An Ordinary Teacher With Amnesia, Managed To Turn His Three Female Students Into A Queen Of Killers, A Queen Of Medicine, And A Queen Of Business?! It Turns Out His True Identity Is An Ancient Immortal Who Lost His Memory And Fell To The Mortal World. Now That He Has Regained Everything, He Decides To Defy Fate With His Disciples And Reclaim His Former Glory!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Outrageous! I Really Didn't Want to Open a Training Class For Empresses!
Outrageous! I Opened a Training Class for Empresses
伝説の仙尊、今世は女弟子を育てます

title.native: 离谱！我真没想开女帝培训班！
title.romaji: Lipu! Wo Zhen Mei Xiang Kai Nüdi Peixun Ban!

197779.description:
Gu Beichen accidentally crossed the world of Xiuzhen, but became a cowherd baby. When he was at a loss, he actually got the artifact that the ancient god Pangu waist had conjured: the Hundred Wives Spectrum! As long as a woman calls her husband, she can have their spiritual power and spiritual roots?!

“Holy Maiden, call Daddy... Ahh Listen to...”

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Hundred Wives: All Saintesses Call Me Husband

title.native: 百妻谱：圣女都叫我夫君
title.romaji: Bai Qi Pu: Sheng Nü Dou Jiao Wo Fujun

197780.description:
When the sadistic heroine travels through time and space to the body of the puppet princess of a fallen nation in a 18+ novel... Can she keep herself unscathed in a den teeming with hungry wolves?

"Wait... Didn't they say this is a pure love story? Why are there so many perverted male protagonists?!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

197782.description:
Chen Wan, a smooth-talking person, infiltrated the princeling clique through his meticulous and reliable approach. Wherever he's around, even the humidity is just right. His efforts aren't about hoping Zhao Shengge will like him. Chen Wan doesn't leave his name or take credit. Zhao Shengge doesn't even need to know him personally; just a chance encounter or two in the same circle is enough. A friend is disappointed: What do you want? "Nothing," Chen Wan smiled, his unwavering secret love creed unbreakable. "If you must say, just that my presence makes him feel a little happier and more comfortable."

Zhao Shengge is a favored child, holding a high position of power. Chen Wan is self-aware and doesn't harbor any illusions about the impossible, nor does he believe his actions are flawless. When they met at an auction, Chen Wan would hide in the crowd and greet others respectfully; when he picked up someone's belongings, he would ask his friends to pass them on; when someone came over and wanted to make connections, he would apologize and tell them that they didn't know him. He really thought so. Until on the cruise ship, the other person bit his cigarette, stared at him quietly and slowly said: "Chen Wan, I don't have a lighter."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

197783.description:
Su-Yeong, a man who lost his dreams in an unexpected accident, embarks on a cruise with his younger sister, Hui-Su. However, a mysterious virus spreads throughout the island, and monsters that take human heads attack. The protagonist is separated from his sister, and the only escape is the vast ocean. Will Su-Yeong be able to find his sister and safely escape the cruise?

(Source: Naver, translated)

synonyms: Meisaku Manga 3: Robin Hood no Bouken
名作マンガ3 ロビン=フットの冒険

197785.description:
Once a top-tier idol, Ju-Won is now forced to watch as his juniors steal the spotlight. Desperate to save his dying career, he tracks down the high-profile sponsor backing the industry’s rising rookies: Madam Noh. But the woman behind the power isn't interested in the usual games. Stripped of his pride and faced with her cold, direct demands, Ju-Won must decide how far he’s willing to go to stay in the limelight. The stage has changed, and the only audience that matters now is her.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ขอให้ผมได้เป็นทาส

197786.description:
Sung-Yeon's long-time crush on her superior Jae-Yoon takes an unexpected turn when a night of drunken confusion leads her to wake up in his house. She uncovers a secret that won’t leave her mind and is left wondering if the man she thought was gentle and professional is hiding a much wilder side.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: ของดีใต้สูทดำ

197787.description:
Tale of a high school professor and student.

Note:
- Setona Mizushiro`s debut work under the pen name Sayaka Mizunari, published on magazine Petit Comic 1993-04
- Won the 31st Shogakugan New Author Comic Award.
synonyms: The Winter Was Trying to End

title.native: 冬が、終わろうとしていた。

197788.description:
While filming a TV animal program about feral dogs tearing up an apartment complex’s trash area, the crew stumbles upon a mysterious man living among them…who just so happens to be the boss of a gang of loan sharks. With no one able to train the man-beast, he is brought to Lee Ji-Ryong: star dog trainer in a heap of debt. In exchange for bringing their boss back to form, the sharks promise to eliminate all of his debt. Jumping at the opportunity, Ji-Ryong takes it on…only to find out that this wild “canine” companion has both bite and bark alike.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Turning Over a New Leaf Is Hard

197789.description:
University student Mikado Kasuga lives for his favorite streamer, Zurich (real name: Rihito Nakahara). Convinced he’s the only one who truly understands the man behind the screen, Mikado goes to an event to see his idol in person. But their meeting doesn’t go the way he imagined—and Mikado soon learns that Zurich also has a peculiar and mutual attachment to him. A unique BL about the twisted, codependent bond between an obsessive streamer and possessive fan.

(Source: Manga UP!)

197790.description:
One day, Do-Ha appears before Do-Hun, calling him hyung as if they were brothers. But something feels wrong. Do-Hun soon realizes that this visitor is not human at all, but a figure pulled straight from the recurring dreams that have haunted him for years. Since Do-Ha’s arrival, strange and unsettling events begin to twist Do-Hun’s once-normal life. His own parents turn against him, he can never seem to get any rest at night, and the line between dream and waking starts to dissolve. As fear takes hold, Do-Hun grows convinced that the only way to end this nightmare is to kill the thing wearing his brother’s face. But when he finally confronts Do-Ha, the creature only smiles and murmurs, “You can’t get rid of me, hyung. It’s impossible. So let’s stay together forever.”

Now Do-Hun must face a terrifying question: is Do-Ha real—or just the reflection of his own fractured mind?

(Source: Lezhin US)

197791.description:
"I remember every moment I spent with Eve-his voice, his expressions, everything."
At a prestigious magic academy, Eve, a cheerful senior from the dog clan, can't wait for the annual buddy selection ceremony. But pairing day delivers a nightmare: his new partner is Aura, a top wolf-clan student surrounded by dark rumors.
Opposite in both personality and magic, the two immediately clash. Eve prepares for a miserable term of endless fighting, but as tension turns to curiosity, he glimpses a different side to his partner-and stumbles upon a secret that changes everything.

(Source: CLLENN)
197791.hashtag: #ふたりよがりなメルティチャーム #ふたメル

title.english: A Melty Charm for Pair Pleasure
title.native: ふたりよがりなメルティチャーム

197792.description:
For seven years, Seo Hyeon-Jin, a Korean literature major, has nursed a secret crush on his upperclassman Soon Jeong-Wook. Unfortunately, Jeong-Wook only sees him as a cherished junior, leaving Hyeon-Jin’s love life at a standstill. Everything changes when Heo Chan-Yeong, who perfectly matches Jeong-Wook’s type, transfers in. To make matters worse, Chan-Yeong boldly confesses his feelings for Jeong-Wook to Hyeon-Jin, explaining that he wants to sleep with him. As if that weren’t enough, Chan-Yeong even asks Hyeon-Jin to help him win Jeong-Wook’s heart. Determined to protect the man he loves, Hyeon-Jin finds himself caught in a battle of wits against Chan-Yeong, who only wants Jeong-Wook out of curiosity.

But when Hyeon-Jin realizes Chan-Yeong’s “interest” might not be so fixed after all, he starts to wonder…could the rival he’s trying to fend off become something else entirely?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

197793.description:
Actor Gyeong Wu-Hyeon is a devoted fan of painter Do Han-Ah. When a treasured piece of Han-ah’s artwork is stolen from him, Wu-Hyeon is devastated, but fate steps in when he unexpectedly runs into Han-ah again at a charity event. To his surprise, Han-ah doesn’t remember him at all, and a small misunderstanding quickly snowballs into the two of them falling into bed. Determined not to let the moment slip away, Wu-Hyeon sets out to show Han-ah just how much he truly values his work. As Han-Ah slowly begins to open up, he finds himself drawn to Wu-Hyeon… yet every now and then, he catches a cool, unreadable side to Wu-Hyeon that he just can’t figure out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197794.description:
Hua Tuo, the highest-ranking Chinese doctor of the late Han Dynasty, is possessed by a modern-day surgical intern!

“It’s so vain.” Hua-bu, who was known as a divine doctor, dies in prison from a curse that wasn’t a curse of Cao Cao…

“Is he still alive?”

When he opens his eyes in excruciating pain, what he sees are… unfamiliar objects and letters he’s never seen before!

“W-what’s going on? Am I, am I possessed by the body of a doctor from another world?”

Memories of the body’s owner, Lee Min-Ho, flood into Hua Tuo’s mind. No matter how different the world is, how on earth does a world like this exist…!

“Who summoned me into the body of this young man?”

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

197795.description:
A demon from the underworld possessing a human?!

Bella, the demon and monarch of the underworld, is possessed by the villainess Isabella Dunkeld, hated by her family and pointed at by everyone as a villainess. 'How did I end up in this body?' She has no memory of making a contract with the human Isabella, and when she came to, she was trapped in Isabella's body with all her powers sealed. She decides to act like a 'human' for the time being, but...

"So how many people have I killed with these hands? Hundreds? Thousands?"

"Huh... You didn't kill a single person?"

"You're calling me a villainess when you didn't kill a single person?"

The demon Bella really finds humans difficult...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

197797.description:
Nari is a half-fox demon, born of a yokai and a human. Having learned to shapeshift and live in human society, Nari comes to the city to find "Chi-chan," the human girl he once promised to marry as a child. However, Nari, bewildered by the unfamiliar city, keeps running into trouble, with his transformation failing or drunks harassing him!

The one who saves him from all this is Chihiro, a smart and cheerful young man... Nari ends up staying at Chihiro's place, who gives off a comforting scent, and there, he learns a shocking truth!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

197802.description:
Suda, a salaryman, spends his dull days doing nothing more than commuting to work and back. One day, after getting back home from a grueling shift, Kousaka, an underclassman from his high school days, turns up on his doorstep with a shocking request: "Please be my owner!"

Thus begins Suda's sudden cohabitation with an uninvited dog! And it seems like he's taken in an audacious dog at that!!!

(Source: Animate International)

197804.description:
Akira, feeling left behind now that his childhood friend has found a lover, is helped by a young man who finds him passed out drunk on the street. The man introduces himself as "Ema," and instead of accepting thanks, hands him a business card, saying "Please request me next time."

Meanwhile, Ema, a male escort who spent just one night with Akira, begins to realize that he's actually looking forward to being requested by him again. If he hadn't met him as Ema, if Akira wasn't a customer...

To you, who struggles to be loved, I will reach out my hand again and again.
A love that warms like the dawn!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

"Get some sex back in your life!"
A romantic comedy for grown-up women ♪

Her husband rejected her and she hasn't had sex in three years, and on top of that, he's had an affair at work... After getting divorced, Ichika, a woman in her 30s, has reset her workplace and her home. Deciding to reset herself, who has always laughed and endured everything, she heads to... a happening bar!? There she meets a mysterious handsome man named Ritsu, and a relationship begins that is sweeter than a sex friend and more relaxed than a romantic one!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197808.description:
At his high school entrance ceremony, Genta couldn't stop thinking about Yuki, his childhood friend he had grown distant from. No matter how hard he tried to fill the emptiness with new friends and skateboarding, all that remained in his heart was regret. If only he could go back to that day, he wouldn't have avoided him. Meanwhile, Yuki also regretted what had happened. He was haunted by the memory of Genta's bewildered face when he had almost kissed him, unable to hide his feelings any longer. Bound by bittersweet emotions, what awaits the two who still think of one another...?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197809.description:
I want to become a magician who makes everyone happy!

Kanji is training to be a magician, performing table magic at a bar. One night, he meets Nose, a salaryman who looks hopeless as he stares at the underpass. For Nose, who has lost his purpose in life, Kanji decides to perform some magic! The next day, Nose shows up at his workplace looking refreshed. "Thanks to you, I had a special time. I want to be your special someone," he confesses in front of Kanji's coworkers and customers, like a proposal!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

197822.description:
Kangjin, an unremarkable idol, seizes the chance to star alongside A-list actor, Heegwon, in a cliché-ridden cop movie. Though they start off on the wrong foot, when Kangjin’s secret crush on a fellow group member is on the verge of being exposed, Kangjin is forced to beg Heegwon to pose as his lover.

(Source: Manta)

197823.description:
Bang Mo-A, an influencer addicted to social media and driven by a life of ease, finds herself captivated by Lee Dan, a lonely, hipster(?) top art student.

"Am I too ordinary to handle your art world? Then I just need to break free from the ordinary!"

Her efforts to win her crush send her life spiraling in an unexpected direction...? Is it possible to achieve both self-actualization and love?

This campus romantic comedy depicts the twenties and thirties of a man and a woman with polar opposite personalities.

(Source: Naver, translated)

197825.description:
After his K-pop debut dreams were shattered, former trainee Takumi returns home and discovers skateboarding. As he slowly begins moving forward with his life, Takumi starts to feel something new...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197826.description:
"Let me help you gain some dating experience."

One day, rookie male teacher Moegi is approached by a male student seeking relationship advice. But what happens when Moegi himself has zero dating experience? A romantic comedy about "learning about love" by Akari Kajimoto.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197827.description:
Some say there are over 50 million participants in this national sport that needs no introduction—"Lotion Sumo." Asato Mizu brings you this classic coming-of-age sports story about young girls covered in sweat, tears, and lotion!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197828.description:
Undercover cop Im Sae-Byeok has one job: use his baby-faced charm to infiltrate a university and get close to Ma Leo, the elusive grandson of a notorious gang boss. But on day one, he gets blackout drunk and wakes up next to a mystery man he definitely doesn’t remember. Things only get messier when he discovers he’ll be living under the same roof as both Leo and Leo’s overly clingy best friend, Son Yi-Gang. With cockblocks, close calls, and suspiciously attractive housemates at every turn, Sae-Byeok’s mission quickly spirals into chaos. Operation Leo might just be his wildest assignment yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197829.description:
My wife is 70 years younger than me.

2118, USA. Dean lost his wife in a car accident. When he hears of a man who disappeared without a trace thanks to a Time Paradox, he makes a plan to pass painlessly and join his wife. And so, Dean travels 50 years into the future. He meets a woman there. She looks shocked to see him. "Are you..?"

(Source: Manta)

197830.description:
A pharmaceutical company started to secretly develop a new drug. The new drug's goal was to prevent humans from aging. They finally succeeded in developing the new drug after three years of research, but it couldn't be trusted without a clinical trial. Eventually, the researchers began testing the drug on people of unknown status illegally. As a result, 12 of the 20 subjects lost their body rhythm within a week and no longer aged. However, as the researchers became eager to report the findings, an unexpected change in the subjects' bodies began.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The Muhyeon Palace (無紋弓), a bow without strings that can kill anyone, and the Muin Island (無刃刀), a sword without blades that can't be pierced. Their journey together began. In the midst of the world's great injustice, wrought by narrow-mindedness, self-righteousness, greed, and resentment, one became a killer, the other a treasure. And so, as if by fate, they began their journey together.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

197836.description:
Death..!! Life..!! For a killer, winning or losing is not important! There are only two paths: kill or be killed..! A killer's fate is to kill his target to survive! That's why we came here at the client's request to carry out the mission. Only to take one life... But we shouldn't have come here today!!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

197838.description:
I was just a commoner, living in blood, hanging by the neck on the edge of a knife... but in a barley famine where it was hard to make a living, I had a job that guaranteed me a lifetime, a stable high income... and an abundance of work that never dried up no matter how much I killed! I was so happy... but that peaceful daily life was shattered only a month or two ago.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

197840.description:
No one knows how the pampered and wicked Erin Lisus suddenly becomes a top swordsman at Atenz Academy. That's because they don't realize that Erin was actually transported to the past after being killed by her stepmother and was reborn into different worlds. Now, with her past experience as a swordmaster, Erin's out to get revenge and rescue her allies from her stepmother's grasp. But with foes at every corner, can Erin save her loved ones? Or will her reason to wield the sword vanish with them?

(Source: Tapas)

197841.description:
As the descendant of a legendary hero, Idnia Katze inherited a power that makes her as imposing as a workhorse. But when she's forced to enroll at a prestigious academy to avoid her own death, she realizes she should probably rein it in; otherwise, she might just steal the spotlight from the future saint and become an obstacle in her quest to save the world! In a place where the professors' egos are rivaled only by the noble students' pride, she's got her work cut out for her...

(Source: Tapas)

Share house "Jukebox" welcomes you to meet its eccentric residents: an angel and a demon, a magician and her apprentice, a doujin writer (hoping to get his works serialized) and a prodigy illustrator from the Edo period… Though all of them are dealing with their own kinds of affairs, they still live under the same roof and thus can get along well with each other. Be their guest in this household where every day is a triple-blown blast!

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

197846.description:
Bong-Gu, a country girl with a penchant for mischief, and her equally quirky family create a daily chaos! This story, filled with laughter and tears, is based on the author's own experiences and portrays 100% authentic rural life.

197847.description:
Hatoba Nanakusa, a student in the arts department of a local university, is extremely unhealthy. Through a strange turn of events, she ends up donating her blood to a vampire youkai girl named Yomogi. She points out that her blood tastes as bad as sewer water, and the two decide to work together to get healthy!

After being betrayed by her fiancé, pharmacist Amelie loses her job and her home. She ends up in the forbidden "Monster Forest." She is saved by Cyril, the third prince of a neighboring kingdom, feared as the "Cruel Prince." His gaze, contrary to rumors, is surprisingly straightforward... "I need you." Slowly, her wounded heart begins to heal. And so begins a new story of love and life.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

197850.description:
Liz is an average commoner who's not only clumsy, but has the worst luck. After several failed attempts, she finally lands a job at the office for the Royal Military's Beast Knights, a special unit where trained knights partner with fierce, dangerous creatures known as "white beasts." Thing is, she doesn't even remember applying there! As soon as she begins working, she's tasked with delivering some documents to Jed Grayson, the commander, and winds up discovering his secret! To keep her under his watchful eye, the commander reassigns her to the role of caretaker for the young white beasts! Will Liz survive her new "fluff-filled" job with her handsome yet sadistic boss?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

197851.description:
"You're going to fall to your death?"
"Huh?"
"I'd prefer you to live if possible. Because if you die, I'll die too."

Seo Hae-Won met a man on a bridge while drunk. He thought they'd accidentally spent a night together, but he told him he'd known Ji-Hun for a very long time. And that's all? At the edge of a cliff in his life, which had seemed so bleak, he nonchalantly reached out.

"What I want isn't your gratitude, Ji-Hun."
"So... are you saying we should date?"
"Dating won't do. That won't satisfy me. Love me. Just like I love you, Ji-Hun."

Hae-Won, seemingly stunned by the passionate confession of love from a stranger, simply added refreshingly.

"Shall we break it down into five stages?"
"... Stages?"
"Stage one is sex, stage two is kissing."

He'd already had sex and kissed. So what are the remaining stages three, four, and five? And, who on earth is that man in Seo Hae-Won?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Mia, who left her hometown due to an unfortunate incident in her childhood, returns to a place she barely remembers, but here, even greater misfortunes befall her.

197853.description:
Han Se-Young, an ordinary high school student, witnesses her childhood friend Kim Jin-Seo's suicide and subsequent resurrection as a living corpse. After coming into contact with the now-dead Jin-Seo, Se-Young becomes infected with a parasite called "Weeper," gaining extraordinary physical abilities. This leads to her recruitment into the "Secret Life Safety Bureau," a secret police force tasked with eliminating Weeper.

Kang-Ha lost her boyfriend, her job, and, most recently, her bike. And just when things were at their worst, she meets her neighbor. Tall, handsome, mysterious... in a word, perfect. That is, except his tendency to transform into a frog.

Then one day, he meets Aoki, an older man working at an izakaya, and slowly begins to experience emotions he has never felt before. A story of one unforgettable summer, both the worst and the best.

A 30-year-old part-time worker spots a prostitute who looks exactly like his first crush from middle school. Determined not to ruin those memories, he keeps his distance, content to just watch her night after night. But when a certain incident pushes him over the edge, he finally decides to approach her. Before he can hand over the cash, however, she gives him a "condition" he never saw coming.

Ruri is a young veterinary doctor who loves youkai, and Fujinome is a nine-tailed fox whose powers have been weakened by a curse, and they journey to treat youkai.

A "bloody school love comedy" about a former human artificial vampire named Roa and a twisted genius assistant to a doctor, Toru. After being turned into an artificial vampire who feeds on blood by a dark organization, Roa ends up attending high school as a normal girl, but...

An old man was laid off from his job at a black company. While wallowing in the depths of his despair, he encounters a mysterious stone that sends him to another world filled with magic and alchemy. The man finds himself reincarnated as Hiyo — the youngest daughter of the demon lord.

Hiyo attempts to make a dazzling fresh start in life by utilizing both her newfound magical powers and prior tribulations as a salaryman, however, the demon world is in the midst of a battle for succession. In order to change herself, the ex-old man is determined to defy the demon lord and her siblings. And after meeting Ernest, a hero with his own circumstances, they work together to take over the throne of the demon lord — for both the sake of peace and to search for a place to belong. The two of them defy destiny, even if it means destroying the world to do so...

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: The Old Man That Was Reincarnated as a Young Girl in the Demon World Wants to Become the Demon Lord for the Sake of Peace

Welcome aboard! Welcome to the unknown world of flight attendants, as depicted by a real former flight attendant! What kind of image do you have of flight attendants? We will guide you on a tough yet funny "real journey"!!

Yuzuru, a novelist in a slump, hears that her grandmother wants to her to take over her business. Hoping to run it while leisurely writing novels, she accepts, but the place she's entrusted with is, of all places, an old public bath...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

197879.description:
Shinyo, the poster girl for her family's retro coffee shop, strictly checks out men in order to keep the shop afloat, and spends her days searching for the perfect husband. Then, Shiro, a handsome but somewhat off-kilter associate professor of archaeology, appears before her...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

“I’m a vampire.” “Give me your blood, mister.”

A man about to throw himself off a bridge is suddenly stopped by a vampire girl—one who looks just like any other ordinary high school student. He decides he wouldn’t mind dying if it’s at the hands of such a beautiful girl; however, instead of death, an unexpected bond begins to form between them.

From Robico, the beloved creator of My Little Monster and Our Precious Conversations, comes her long awaited new work: a series of tales where humans and the uncanny meet—lost halves finding their echo.

Tired of the dark and cold ocean depths, a mermaid heads to land to find love with a human! There, she meets Torao, a member of a gang. Life together with this dreaming mermaid becomes one turbulent adventure after another...?!

Higuchi, a playboy college student with an ass fetish, is in a good mood with a girl at a party he attends, but he fails to take her home. When he's feeling annoyed, the pretty boy, Hazuki, flirts with him, saying, "I can make you feel better than a girl could." Even though Higuchi is supposed to be straight, he is attracted to Hazuki's ass and sex appeal, and ends up having sex with him! Hazuki's sexy body and elastic ass... He squeezes him tightly inside and is about to cum, but he isn't going to cum that easily, so he thrusts into him deep inside, and Hazuki, who has become sensitive, starts to moan...!

Choose your player: a noble hero intent on saving the world, or a devious demon prince hell-bent on conquering it? A normal choice when playing a new game, but when gaming nerd In-gong Ju wakes up inside the VR game Knight Saga:RE, he finds himself playing as Siutra, a tiny, gnome-like ninth prince of the demon kingdom. In-gong must work quickly to unlock a range of potentially overpowered skills to help him level up and win over his siblings before the Day of Massacres, when they’ll all be slaughtered by the game’s antagonist, Zephyr Ragnaroth.

197889.description:
Eun-Ha’s high-school life takes a dramatic turn when her bullies force her to perform a ghost-summoning ritual that brings Hae-Su, a charming yet unsettling spirit, into her life. Claiming to be her friend, Hae-Su starts exacting revenge on Eun-Ha’s tormentors. However, his violent methods concern Eun-Ha, and she begins searching for answers to uncover the past and his true identity.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197890.description:
Matsumaru, an overweight high school boy who drew the short straw in both the parent and childhood lottery of life. One day, when a woman witnesses him being bullied, she notices something unexpected about him...?

197891.description:
After losing her parents to a heretic trial, Vivian lived quietly alone while concealing her intelligence. However, one day, a villager is suspected of being a Heretic. Cyril, a newly arrived clergy member, persistently demands answers from Vivian...?! An unlikely duo forms to bring the truth to light!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197892.description:
Ayumu Hibi works at the city hall of an ordinary town. As part of the Yokai Division, he responds to daily reports of Yokai-related incidents from citizens. What kind of cases await him today...?

197893.description:
In pursuit of studying theater, Kei journeys to a distant land as a foreign exchange student. Struggling with cultural differences and loneliness, one day she follows a black cat resembling her family pet to a bakery, where a fateful encounter awaits...

197894.description:
Veteran exorcist Shiren Erihara worries about absolutely everything. One day, he goes on a demon hunt with rookie Hajo, but his anxieties are endless - from wondering if he turned off the gas to worrying about losing the rookie's respect. Can this unlikely duo manage to exorcise a powerful demon?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

This season's top hero Kabuto is so swamped with non-stop monster-slaying that he can't even find time to wash his suit - and boy, does it reek! Watch him struggle to squeeze some free time into his packed schedule…

It's Career Day at an elementary school. Yamanaka, who doesn't have a future career in mind, gets forced into spending his Career Day with a "mountain bandit" by his teacher!! What awaits him is the shocking and unlawful world of bandits!

197897.description:
“My sister… Is she really my sister?”

Can you truly say, without a shred of doubt, that the person you love by your side is family? Haruka lost her parents when she was just a child. For a time she was separated from her older sister, Yurina, but now the two live together again, seemingly close as ever. To Haruka, beautiful Yurina is the very picture of the perfect sister.

But even so, two unsettling doubts have taken root in her heart. The first one is that every time Yurina starts dating someone new, she always calls him her “first love.”. And the second one is whether Yurina is truly her sister at all.

Desperate to shake off these suspicions, Haruka opens her sister’s old graduation album. What she discovers inside leaves her reeling. And one night, her worst fears take shape before her eyes. Haruka catches Yurina “carving up” her so-called first love with a kitchen knife…?!

Eun-Gyung is a 28 year old woman with zero luck in the romance department. Longing for her first boyfriend and her first kiss, she instead finds the god of love, Cupid, passed out on her doorstep after being banished from the heavens for abusing his power. Short, bulbous and foul-mouthed, he and Eun-Gyung embark on an unlikely friendship to find love and way back home.

Asana Amamizu, a student at Yotsuru Girls' Academy, has been bullied by her family ever since a red mark appeared on her wrist. So even when the school is abuzz with news about a handsome new Japanese teacher, Asana keeps her distance. That is, until an unexpected marriage proposal comes her way!

The knight from a noble family suddenly made a marriage proposal to me! He probably wants to get rid of me as soon as possible, so I'll have to work hard to make a baby! A love story between a common magic healer and an awkward noble knight.

197911.description:
"I always believed I was the only one who should stand by his side..." Prince Ashley, the first prince of the Kingdom of Sforzia, and Lady Violetta, a duke's daughter, are engaged to be married. Although their engagement was arranged for political reasons, Violetta has worked hard to support him as the crown prince since they were young. However, as she became busier, they started spending less time together, and Ashley became close to a cheerful and naïve young lady, who is Violetta's complete opposite. Then, Violetta hears a shocking rumor: "Poor Lady Violetta. Imagine being cast aside by the crown prince!" Rather than let another young woman take him away, Violetta makes a firm decision: 'Fine, I'll be the one to end this engagement!'

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Judith, a war orphan with supernatural powers, survives thanks to an anonymous benefactor. He showers her with gifts but never replies. When she finally receives a reply, she travels to meet him. But who is her benefactor out of the charming rogue, successful businessman, and snarky gang leader?

197913.description:
After seeing an advertisement, Madoka Ariizumi decides to have her second-grade son take a national mock exam. While she hadn't even considered taking the junior high school entrance exam, Madoka's excitement at Tsubasa's achievements makes her heart race, and her hopes for her son grow.
