The protagonist, Choi Mi-Hun, witnesses his parents' deaths on his middle school graduation day, struck by a truck. The shock of the incident left him diagnosed with panic disorder, making even the smallest details of daily life feel like life-threatening threats. He becomes a shut-in, a hikikomori. His only friend is Seon-Ah, who grew up in the same neighborhood and occasionally visits him. Then one day, suspicious people move in next door, and their suspicious behavior piques Mi-Hun's curiosity...

He wakes up in a place somewhere between life and death where other recently deceased souls stay before moving on to the afterlife. When he realizes that his wife may still be in this place, he races to find her before it's too late.

(Source: SpotToon)

197925.description:
Unable to endure the abuse at his orphanage, Tae-Ju murders the director and flees with nothing. Desperate to end his life, he stumbles upon a church of the Hwasin Faith to confess his sins before dying. It is there that Tae-Ju discovers his true identity: a god of death. In his new life as a god, Tae-Ju is joined by Jeong-Hu, a god-hating elder of Hwasin. Together, they navigate their complex destinies and unravel the mysteries of their divine roles.

Azusa is a university student working as a new host at a "vampire bar" where vampire customers can enjoy the blood of the host. The vampire bar owner scouted Azusa, expecting his blood to have the finest flavor. As a monk, Isana has been unable to shed tears ever since losing his childhood friend, Gunji, a detective who died in the line of duty.
Carrying unresolved anger and unspoken feelings for Gunji, Isana finds himself haunted by a lingering presence.
Every month, on Gunji's memorial day, his junior detective, Tanabe, faithfully visits the grave.
Each time, as Isana is confronted with the depth of his own loss, Tanabe's bright, cheerful personality feels unbearably irritating.
His frustration toward Tanabe, who was once cherished by Gunji, finally spills over into unexpected words...

“Will you comfort me in his place?”

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Fearing it will make him uncomfortable if he were ever to find out, her heart races every time he comes to talk to her. But, one night, he made a move on her, saying, "You love my voice, don't you?" and stole a kiss from her lips. He also whispered into her ear, asking, "Don't you want to hear me say sexy phrases in this voice?"...!?

Standing next to Han Yi-Won, handsome as a melon, I always felt like a sweet potato. Yul-Mi, who had always been compared to his more successful childhood friend, was dumped by his girlfriend. One day, after being dumped by his girlfriend, he fell for Yi-Won's offer to be his practice partner and ended up kissing him... I really hated him, but why do I keep thinking about that day?

197943.description:
The world of works that pioneered an era of experimentation is now illuminated anew as something akin to "poems of youth" curated by Naoki Matayoshi, the foremost contemporary follower of Seiichi Hayashi. As a manga artist symbolizing Garo—which became the core of the seething counterculture vortex in the late 1960s—the author rose to become the darling of the age. Lyrical poetry and action drama, fusion of indigenous and pop art, the clash between cinematic/theatrical and poetic sentiments...

Leading the era of transformation and carving new horizons for expression, this collection of works is curated by contemporary writer Naoki Matayoshi, the foremost follower of Hayashi, as he shines a new light on Hayashi's works. This includes Akai Enamel Kutsu in its first collection, as well as nine other stories.

(Source: Chikuma Shobou, translated)

One summer day, Shiohara, a Boy (male clerk/server) working at a pink salon (type of brothel), was murdered. A story about angry women.

(Source: MeDu Comics, translated)

title.native: ガールズ・アット・ジ・エッジ

197948.description:
A mysterious boy named Song Jiang takes part in a revolution of young heroes, who are trying to change the evils in the world and fight against false leaders.

(Source: SpotToon)

197949.description:
In the near future, a small number of Alphas known as the Awakened are born with extraordinary powers. Diego should have been one of the strongest, but every time he uses his ability, his body betrays him with violent seizures. When he’s introduced to Shane, a quiet scientist who offers to create a stabilizer, Diego begins to feel an inexplicable pull toward him. As buried memories resurface, Diego starts to wonder if their meeting was fate, or the beginning of something that transcends time itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197950.description:
Based on the erotic game by ZION.

Takeshi is a middle-aged businessman who has moved to Tokyo for work. One night, two high school girls, Ami and Nana, approach him for compensated dating, and he ends up having physical relations with them. Attracted by Takeshi's wealth and energetic sex, Ami and the others continue to have sex with him, teaching their young bodies the pleasures of being with a grown man. Through compensated dating, Takeshi meets a variety of unique girls, and his life as a solo worker is filled with the pleasures of youth!!

(Source: Parabook, translated)
synonyms: Enkou JK Bitch Gyaru - Oji-san to Nama Pako Seikatsu

title.native: エンコーJKビッチギャルオジサンとなまパコ性活
title.romaji: Enkou JK Bitch Gal - Oji-san to Nama Pako Seikatsu

197951.description:
I didn't know what you'd like, so I prepared everything. Choose your ideal type. Kwak Sa-Rang, a true beauty who transcends all genders and ages, acts out a different concept every day to become your crush's ideal type...♡

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

197952.description:
Kim Ju-Sa, a poor civil servant living an ordinary life. One day, while busy with work, his forgotten Bitcoin from 10 years ago suddenly skyrockets, making him the owner of 8 billion won and putting into practice the cider office life he always wanted... Kim Ju-Sa's crazy, crazy life with 8 billion won begins..!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

197953.description:
I'm going to tell you a story about a failed relationship. I didn't know it would turn out like this. But everyone has a story like this.

(Source: Naver, translated)

197954.description:
Dianna Brienne frees the abused slave of her estate, Guiscard Lodbrog, only for him to return years later as a vengeful king who repays her compassion with a cruel, humiliating marriage that ends in her tragic death. But fate grants a second chance. Thrown back in time to her twelfth birthday, Dianna must now protect the very boy destined to become her monster before his hatred toward his masters grows deadly. In this life, Dianna won’t be his victim. She will face her future tormentor head-on to rewrite their bloody ending and find a better future together.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Thus, I Married the Monster Twice

title.native: 그렇게, 그 괴물과 두 번 결혼했다
title.romaji: Geureoke, Geu Goemulgwa Du Beon Gyeolhonhaetda

197955.description:
Eun-Seong Oh’s school life was smooth until she caught Yoon-Do Cha’s eye. To endure his attention, she tried befriending him. Yoon-Do had everything yet felt nothing—until Eun-Seong. Maybe it was never friendship at all, but love from the start.

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Kono Ai ni wa, Doku ga Aru.

title.native: ぶりっこねねこちゃん
忘れられない恋をして

197964.description:
To discover the color of his ideal, Kyosuke begins working as an assistant at an art school after graduating. But as he struggles to meet his expectations, he soon drowns into the city and it's "seduction". One night, when Kyosuke is looking for his temporary lover at his go-to bar, he helps out Chigusa, a boy getting picked on in the streets. Seeing Chigusa's naiveness, Kyosuke warns him to go home for the night. However, Chigusa refuses and suggests Kyosuke to "pick him for the night"...

A handsome and popular art school assistant x A rather bratty art school student The two melt into the color that resembles "that day"... A vividly romantic BL begins.

(Source: .ink works)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: When Two Colors Melt Into One
title.native: まぜて絡めてとかして愛でて

197965.description:
"What do you say, Henrietta? Will you serve our kingdom not as its queen, but as the leading mistress of my harem?" One day, Prince Georges came to his betrothed Henrietta with that as a suggestion. It goes without saying that the engagement was broken off. Finally things can calm down... or so Henrietta thought until she received a new letter from her aunt. She is now tasked with going to meet with the current king's much younger brother, Lord Richard, and find some way to seduce him. From what people seem to know, he is an eccentric sort of man who loves to paint and stays cooped up in his manor in the countryside. However, the man Henrietta has been tasked with seducing is actually a handsome charmer himself...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Ordered to Seduce the Beautiful Duke, But Unexpectedly, I'm the One Being Doted On!
title.native: 美麗公爵様を口説いてこいと命じられたのに、予想外に溺愛されています
title.romaji: Birei Koushaku-sama wo Kudoite Koi to Meijirareta no ni, Yosougai ni Dekiai Sarete Imasu

197966.description:
In a small country on a certain continent, Lamberth, there is a being known as a "Saint" who possesses strong healing powers and brings prosperity to the country. Irene, the daughter of a marquis who was engaged to Maynard, the first prince of Lamberth, is suddenly informed by Maynard that he is breaking off their engagement. The previous Saint has died, and it is necessary to decide on the next Saint as soon as possible. The two were originally engaged for political reasons, but Irene is irritated by Maynard's cold attitude. However, at the Saint selection ceremony, Irene is chosen as the true Saint...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 殿下、あなたが捨てた女が本物の聖女です
title.romaji: Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo Desu

title.native: おかえりなさいませ、ご主人様

197969.description:
Hanazawa Moe grew up tall and tomboyish, and was even mocked for "crossdressing" the one time she wore more feminine clothes, which left her with some emotional baggage and a penchant for playing the man. Now Moe is the most popular waiter at a crossdressing cafe, where she dresses up as a guy to welcome lady customers. Thinking it was a dream job that let her use her unique talents, she buried herself in her work, until... Before she knew it, she'd reached "that age" - all her friends are getting married, having kids, and steadily moving forward in life. Suddenly, a voice inside her starts asking, "Do I want to carry on this way forever...?" -- Match-making apps, blind date parties and more... The chronicle of a girl well below the curve on romantic know-how going all out to find a husband!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Digital version has five volumes.
synonyms: She's Looking for Someone to Marry.

title.native: 男装女子が、婚活はじめました

197970.description:
Meet Linear Seven, an alien observer of other alien life forms. When news breaks that Earth is doomed to extinction, she makes her decision: "It's now or never!" And so begins her journey to Earth…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197971.description:
In these times of war, corporations from various nations were zealously developing weapons, competing through live demonstrations of their battle suits. During one mission, Austin, the ace of Nightblower Corp., encounters a fighting salesman from a rival company...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

197972.description:
Yujin has a hopeless crush on his cool and handsome sunbae, Choi Beom. But thanks to Yujin's shy personality, he can't even make eye contact with Beom and even pulls all-nighters because of the questionably sexy dreams he has about them. One day, Yujin accidentally gets trapped in his grandpa’s invention, a machine designed to unlock human potential. Due to a malfunction, Yujin splits into two personas: a nervous nerd and a shameless flirt. Now it's nerd versus flirt in a chaotic battle for Beom’s heart!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Unlock☆ หนุ่มเนิร์ดสุดแซ่บ

title.english: Unlock: The Nerd Boy's Double Life

197973.description:
Always overshadowed alongside her childhood friend Kei, who is considered a "genius," Nagisa is gradually driven away from her love of art. But he won’t let Nagisa go so easily…?

(Source: LaLa, translated)

Note: Originally published in LaLa 2025 Aug. issue's "LaLa Star" supplemental.

197975.description:
Short-story collection:

1.The Snared Siren (浴槽の人魚) [2022]
A tale of a woman who’s living with a horror-movie-loving mermaid! Not to mention, she’s taken up residence in her bathtub.

2. Frozen Dessert Artisan (氷菓子職人) [2020]
A tale of a frozen dessert artisan who’s created the perfect girlfriend. This story is slightly horror-leaning.

3. A Lover’s Call (恋人からの電話) [2022]
A slightly somber tale of a lesbian who enjoys the call they receive each night from their lover.

4. Two Bickering Maids (仲の悪いメイドたち) [2020]
A tale of a princess and her maids who are constantly going at it.

title.native: 浴槽の人魚 百合短編集2020-2024

197978.description:
Choi Seo-Yeon is an avoidant type who, whenever she's in a relationship, breaks up for trivial reasons. She'd always thought she just met the wrong partner... but as she continues to date, she gradually realizes the real problem is her own self. Can she overcome her avoidant personality and have a healthy relationship?

(Source: Naver, translated)

197979.description:
After failing at both love and work, Dokyung returns to the stillness of her hometown, Mooyung, where a chance encounter at her mother’s old corner store brings her face-to-face with Doh Joon, a top actor with eyes like midnight. What begins with a bold proposition soon turns into something far more complicated: a fleeting summer affair between a woman afraid to love again and a man who wants forever. As their days grow hotter and their nights more intimate, Dokyung clings to the idea that it’s just a season, just a moment. But Doh Joon is already dreaming of something that lingers long after summer ends.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197980.description: Note: Chapters 2 and 3 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined on various eBook stores.

197981.description:
Self-published collection of short stories, published in magazines such as Kodansha's Morning and the doujin-zine DICE, between 2014 and 2021.

1. Hataraku Ningen (働く人間)
2. Kaze no Tayori (風のたより) [Original story by Kiyoshi Koyama]
3. Nisesatsu Tsukai (贋札つかい)
4. Iden (遺伝) [Original story by Sakutarou Hagiwara]
5. Spy no Kaban (スパイの鞄)
6. Ushinawareta Tanuki (失われたタヌキ) [Original story by Jun Takami]
7. Kawaikunai Usagi (可愛くないウサギ)
8. Wakare no Kisetsu (別れの季節)
9. Ame ga Furu to wa Kiitenakatta (雨が降るとは聞いてなかった)
10. Aki no Yoru no Yume (秋の夜の夢)

title.native: 雨が降るとは聞いてなかった
title.romaji: Ame ga Furu to wa Kiitenakatta

197982.description: Please just read this important messages for the freedom to marry. Thank you.
197982.hashtag: #エアコミティア137 #結婚の自由をすべての人に

197987.description: The world has been destroyed, but sisters Ikaru and Atori have luckily(?) survived. For some reason, they cannot return to "Sogosie Village," where they used to live. With no way out, the two turn to a life of survival, but to live is to eat. Without food, there is no future. At that time, they come across a large stockpile of sliced bread. Their joy is short-lived though, as sliced bread is an unknown entity to the two. The sisters, who don't even know how to eat it, begin their journey of struggling with sliced bread!

197988.description:
Na-Hee is sent to bring food to Hyun-Jin, the chaebol heir just back from England. She dreads seeing the boy she used to roughhouse with, yet feels sorry for how lonely his glittering penthouse seems—until he corners her and blurts, “How can I see you as just a friend when you’re so damn pretty?”

(Source: Manta)

197989.description:
Not all powers are worth having. Dam-Cho Baek has never doubted that—in fact, she’d do anything to get rid of her ability to hear people’s emotions, a divine gift granted by a foreign god. At the end of her wits, she’s shocked to encounter an exorcist named Jin-Hu Do, who might just know how to do it. The catch? To get rid of her ability, she needs to lose her virginity—but hearing people's thoughts makes that impossible. And since she can’t hear Jin-Hu… maybe he could help her with that too.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: You’re More Dangerous Than the Anomaly

197990.description:
When Song-Ju Han learns that her best friend betrayed her and is getting married to her first love, she's devastated. Wanting comfort, Song-Ju has a drunken one-night stand with her childhood friend Do-Han Baek. A month later, Do-Han demands that she take responsibility and marry him!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: In the end, it all leads to marriage

197991.description:
Lady Sohee is a virtuous widow, honored by the king and devoted to a life of quiet restraint. Yet her heart begins to waver when she grows close to Dukbong, a servant of far lower status. When a chance moment exposes their forbidden feelings, Sohee must choose between her honor and her heart.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Lady Gives White Rice Only to Me

197992.description:
Haru Shirosaki, nine years old, is a 4th-grader who has little thoughts for his future. One day, he visits the "Bird Encyclopedia", a specialty store that features birds from all over the world. What will happen when the boy meets Enji Kochikawa, the store's manager, who's full of dreams and wild ideas...!?

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)
synonyms: Me and the Bird Encyclopedia Store

197993.description:
A man who lost everything in an instant. He sets out on a murderous rampage, seeking revenge. WhiIe evading a police officer who will do anything to stop him.

(Source: DAYcomics)

197994.description:
Jeong Min-Jae, who came to Seoul from the countryside, wants to write poetry with respect. Han Gyeo-Wool, entangled in the past, wants to conclude her story with a novel. The story of creative writing students, each writing for their own goals.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Note: Includes a prologue chapter.

197995.description: The tale of a flower that blooms by inhaling memories. But even if our memories are taken from us, some precious things are never forgotten. "I don't fear losing my memory if I can feel this way again tomorrow..."

197996.description: Byakuya had an incurable undying illness, which means he couldn't die. Gin, his best friend, made a promise that he would take care of Byakuya until death and the promise had been kept for 16 generations. However, Gin the Sixteenth had no intention of making babies for the next generation; instead, he kept his promise with Byakuya in a way that none of the previous Gins had done.

197998.description: Hatsune, whose body was brought by a house of prostitution, is a model for the artist Suzuro. This male prostitute Hatsune was sold by his lover, his brother, who he continues to yearn for. He is also enchanted by Suzuro. Ironically, his brother has been hired as the bodyguard on the same street.

197999.description:
She's starring in the role of her lifetime.

It's 1931, and Lee-Won's brother has been framed. As she tries to escape with him, she's knocked out and wakes up in the 21st century. When she's then asked to play the character of On Lee-Won in a film, she realizes that it's the story of her own past and resolves to find out who framed her brother.

(Source: Manta)
